descriptionHtml:
About SquadStack.ai :-


SquadStack.ai is on a mission to transform the $450B global customer experience market. We’re building an AI-native, vertically integrated platform that combines AI agents, human agents, software and deep workflow orchestration to deliver sales & cx services-as-software at scale.

If you’re excited about building products at the frontier of AI, voice, and platform abstraction—this is your playground.


Role Overview :-

We’re looking for a Product Manager who’s equal parts strategist, builder, and visionary—someone who wants to shape the future of AI in customer experience. In this role, you’ll lead the development of our Voice AI platform and the go-to-market for our agentic voice AI

This is a high-ownership, zero-to-one opportunity to define product strategy, scale infrastructure, and empower developers and businesses to build with SquadStack’s AI capabilities.


What you'll be doing :-


Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and lead the roadmap for our Voice AI platform, aligning product initiatives with the company vision.
  • Work with leadership to translate abstract ideas into product strategy and modular platform offerings.
  • Stay ahead of trends in LLMs, agentic workflows, voice AI, and platform ecosystems.


Product Development & Execution

  • Collaborate with engineering, design, and data science to ship high-quality, high-leverage products.
  • Translate user needs into APIs, SDKs, and platform components that external teams can build on.
  • Lead the product lifecycle end-to-end—from problem discovery to post-launch iteration.


Go-to-Market & Ecosystem Building

  • Design a thoughtful GTM strategy with business teams: pricing, positioning, self-serve onboarding, and documentation.
  • Work closely with sales, marketing, and success to drive adoption across enterprises and SMEs.
  • Gather feedback from early adopters, devs, and internal users to iterate fast.


Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the product bridge across internal teams (infra, sales, CX ops)
  • Evangelise platform thinking across the company—driving clarity on where we build vs expose.


What We Want :-

Required

  • 7-8 years of experience in product management, preferably in AI, SaaS, or PaaS.
  • Ex-Engineers or Technical/ Data Background (but now product-focused)
  • Understand AI-native or workflow orchestration products
  • Have worked on extensible platforms or developer products
  • Can marry infra thinking with product-led GTM, and build for both enterprise and SME/long-tail devs
  • Clear, compelling communication—can explain complex concepts to both engineers and execs.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience building or launching PaaS or workflow automation tools.
  • Founder or early-stage startup experience—bias for action and clarity under chaos.
  • Exposure to LLM tooling, voice AI, or agentic workflows.

Logistics

  • Compensation: Competitive!
  • Joining: ASAP!
  • Location: Noida


Why join us?

  • Build at the cutting edge of AI & CX
  • Work with a high-context team that values speed, clarity, and ambition.
  • Influence not just product, but company direction—PMs become revenue drivers at our org
  • Competitive salary, ESOPs, and the opportunity to own a large surface area of impact.


Please Note:

SquadStack.ai is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. SquadStack.ai is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status

About the Role: Looking for an experienced Product Owner/Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and delivery of RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) platform and rApp. You will own the product backlog , roadmap, define use cases , solution with cross product owner and work closely with engineering, pre-sales, and customer teams to deliver measurable outcomes for Tier-1 and Tier-2 operators globally.

  • High-impact role with direct influence on product strategy and company direction
  • Close collaboration with experienced leadership and world-class engineering teams
  • Exposure to large-scale datasets and AI-driven product innovation

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

  • Own Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages.
  • Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives.
  • Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion.
  • Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages.
  • Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions.
  • Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and Product
  • Manage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region.
  • Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs.

Qualifications

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth SaaS or product-led company.
  • Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption.
  • Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces.
  • Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams.
  • Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments.
  • A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing.
  • Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design.

Additional Information

About the Group/Team

Canva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution.

In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India.

About The Role/Specialty

As the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences.

This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale.

descriptionHtml:
About the Company



We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager II to drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of our personalization and discovery experiences. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in building customer-centric digital products and deep expertise in Personalization, Search, Recommendation Systems, User Engagement, and Product Analytics.



About the Role



You will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Analytics, and Business stakeholders to deliver highly scalable and impactful product experiences that improve user engagement, retention, and business outcomes.



Responsibilities



  • Define and execute product vision, strategy, and roadmap for personalization and discovery platforms.
  • Own end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch and optimization.
  • Drive initiatives related to Search, Recommendations, Personalization, Ranking, and User Journey Optimization.
  • Collaborate with Data Science and Engineering teams to build and enhance ML-powered recommendation and personalization capabilities.
  • Analyze user behavior, customer feedback, and market trends to identify growth opportunities.
  • Define product requirements, success metrics, and KPIs.
  • Lead A/B testing, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Work cross-functionally with UX, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, and Business teams.
  • Prioritize product backlog and ensure timely delivery of high-impact features.
  • Monitor product performance and continuously optimize customer experience.



Qualifications



  • 9–12 years of Product Management experience, preferably in consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, OTT, or large-scale digital platforms.



Required Skills



  • Strong experience in:
  • Personalization
  • Search & Discovery
  • Recommendation Systems
  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Planning
  • User Experience Optimization
  • Product Analytics
  • Experimentation & A/B Testing
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Experience working closely with Data Science and Machine Learning teams.
  • Strong understanding of customer behavior, engagement, and retention metrics.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Proven track record of launching and scaling successful digital products.



Preferred Skills



  • Experience with AI/ML-driven products and recommendation engines.
  • Exposure to personalization frameworks, ranking algorithms, and search optimization.
  • MBA from a reputed institute is preferred.
  • Experience in high-growth product organizations.

descriptionHtml:
This role is for one of the Weekday's clients

Min Experience: 10+ years

Location: Hyderabad

JobType: full-time

We are seeking a visionary and high-impact Principal Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and user experience. A leader who operates with a high degree of autonomy, strategic foresight and influence senior stakeholders and mentor mid-level PMs. You are someone who has mastered the craft of product management and is now looking to apply those skills to solve our most complex, ambiguous, and high-stakes challenges. You aren't just an executor; you are a visionary who raises the standard for the entire Product org.

What a "Principal PM" means to us

At this level, "Principal" signifies a person who serves as a primary architect of our product culture and strategy. You are a peer to senior engineering and design leadership, responsible for ensuring our product ecosystem is cohesive, scalable, and commercially dominant. You represent the "voice of the product" in high-level business discussions and act as a force multiplier for every team you touch. To us, this role means owning high-stakes product outcomes that span across multiple squads, ensuring that our technical capabilities are always aligned with our long-term commercial goals.

Requirements

How you can help us

There are certain functions and capabilities we believe are essential to this internship:

  • Strategy & Vision: Translate our company mission into a multi-year product roadmap that anticipates market shifts
  • Organizational Strategy: Identify and bridge gaps between business goals and technical execution across multiple product domains
  • Market Leadership: Conduct high-level market and competitive analysis to pivot or double down on long-term growth levers
  • Craft Excellence: Define and implement the "gold standard" for product discovery, delivery, and measurement across the organization
  • Operational Excellence: Identify bottlenecks in our delivery process and implement scalable solutions to improve velocity and quality
  • Cross-functional Orchestration: Bridge the gap between Engineering, Design, Sales, and Marketing to ensure a unified product voice
  • Mentorship: Elevate the craft of product management across the organization by sharing best practices and refining our internal playbooks
  • Strategic Advocacy: Influence executive stakeholders and the Board by articulating a clear, data-backed vision for the future of our platform

What We Consider Relevant Qualifications, Experience And Knowledge

To succeed in this role and fast-track toward an Associate position, you should bring:

  • Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or Principal level within a fast-scaling tech environment and a proven track record of delivering massive impact in high-complexity environments
  • Domain Expertise: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-sided platforms or high-growth B2B/B2C products
  • Technical Literacy: A deep understanding of system architecture and the ability to hold your own in technical discussions with Engineers
  • Communication: Exceptional storytelling skills, you can simplify the complex for a board-level audience
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated ability to drive product strategy from inception to post-launch optimization
  • Mentorship at Scale: Experience coaching Senior and Staff-level PMs, elevating the talent density of your previous organizations
  • Leadership & Influence: Expert-level stakeholder management skills; you can navigate conflicting priorities and drive consensus at the VP and C-suite level

Performance indicators to get you off to a great start

We don't expect you to know everything on Day 1, but we do expect you to grow fast. Here is how we will measure your success:

  • Day 30: Conduct a "listening tour" across the organization and present an initial assessment of our current product gaps and opportunities
  • Day 60: Take full ownership of a major strategic initiative and define a clear 6-month roadmap with validated KPIs
  • Day 90: Successfully lead one major product release or framework improvement and begin mentoring at least one Senior PM on specific craft skills

Must-have Skills

Product Manager

Good-to-have Skills

Fintech

descriptionHtml:
This role is for one of the Weekday's clients

Min Experience: 10+ years

Location: Hyderabad

JobType: full-time

We are seeking a visionary and high-impact Principal Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and user experience. A leader who operates with a high degree of autonomy, strategic foresight and influence senior stakeholders and mentor mid-level PMs. You are someone who has mastered the craft of product management and is now looking to apply those skills to solve our most complex, ambiguous, and high-stakes challenges. You aren't just an executor; you are a visionary who raises the standard for the entire Product org.

What a "Principal PM" means to us

At this level, "Principal" signifies a person who serves as a primary architect of our product culture and strategy. You are a peer to senior engineering and design leadership, responsible for ensuring our product ecosystem is cohesive, scalable, and commercially dominant. You represent the "voice of the product" in high-level business discussions and act as a force multiplier for every team you touch. To us, this role means owning high-stakes product outcomes that span across multiple squads, ensuring that our technical capabilities are always aligned with our long-term commercial goals.

Requirements

How you can help us

There are certain functions and capabilities we believe are essential to this internship:

  • Strategy & Vision: Translate our company mission into a multi-year product roadmap that anticipates market shifts
  • Organizational Strategy: Identify and bridge gaps between business goals and technical execution across multiple product domains
  • Market Leadership: Conduct high-level market and competitive analysis to pivot or double down on long-term growth levers
  • Craft Excellence: Define and implement the "gold standard" for product discovery, delivery, and measurement across the organization
  • Operational Excellence: Identify bottlenecks in our delivery process and implement scalable solutions to improve velocity and quality
  • Cross-functional Orchestration: Bridge the gap between Engineering, Design, Sales, and Marketing to ensure a unified product voice
  • Mentorship: Elevate the craft of product management across the organization by sharing best practices and refining our internal playbooks
  • Strategic Advocacy: Influence executive stakeholders and the Board by articulating a clear, data-backed vision for the future of our platform

What We Consider Relevant Qualifications, Experience And Knowledge

To succeed in this role and fast-track toward an Associate position, you should bring:

  • Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or Principal level within a fast-scaling tech environment and a proven track record of delivering massive impact in high-complexity environments
  • Domain Expertise: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-sided platforms or high-growth B2B/B2C products
  • Technical Literacy: A deep understanding of system architecture and the ability to hold your own in technical discussions with Engineers
  • Communication: Exceptional storytelling skills, you can simplify the complex for a board-level audience
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated ability to drive product strategy from inception to post-launch optimization
  • Mentorship at Scale: Experience coaching Senior and Staff-level PMs, elevating the talent density of your previous organizations
  • Leadership & Influence: Expert-level stakeholder management skills; you can navigate conflicting priorities and drive consensus at the VP and C-suite level

Performance indicators to get you off to a great start

We don't expect you to know everything on Day 1, but we do expect you to grow fast. Here is how we will measure your success:

  • Day 30: Conduct a "listening tour" across the organization and present an initial assessment of our current product gaps and opportunities
  • Day 60: Take full ownership of a major strategic initiative and define a clear 6-month roadmap with validated KPIs
  • Day 90: Successfully lead one major product release or framework improvement and begin mentoring at least one Senior PM on specific craft skills

Must-have Skills

Product Manager

Good-to-have Skills

Fintech

Description

Are you interested in building high-performance, globally scalable Financial systems and infrastructure that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Does the prospect of working with top finance and engineering talent get you charged up? If so, Amazon Finance Technology (FinTech) is for you!

Amazon FinTech is looking for a Senior Product Manager Technical (PM-T) to deliver long term scalable product that will help our Accounting and Finance customers improve financial reconciliations processes, accelerate financial close cycle, enhance controllership and reduce manual effort through automation.

We are seeking an experienced, results-oriented, self-motivated Technical Product Manager, having a bent for solving complex problems and delivering high quality technical products. You will be responsible for developing product strategy, defining product requirements working with global internal accounting teams, influencing stakeholders and engineering teams required to deliver an impactful product.

The ideal candidate for this role will have strong ownership, business and product sense combined with a solid understanding of financial and accounting concepts. You will need to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment without being hindered by ambiguity. High judgment, ability to influence, analytical talent, exceptional communications, the ability to partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders and leadership are essential to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities

  • Define product requirements and execution strategy for an enterprise product
  • Lead the product life cycle including vision, strategy, roadmap, requirements, user experience, delivery, launch, and support.
  • Work with engineering, research, UX, technical program managers and stakeholders to deliver a successful product
  • Collaborate with Amazon partner tech teams to ensure product re-usability and avoid redundancies.
  • Managing both upwards and downwards communications effectively

About The Team

FinTech’s charter is to enable Finance & Global Business Services (FGBS) teams, and amplify the benefit of FGBS teams to support the growth, expansion, and restructuring of the businesses. The Close Systems team owns coordination, execution and continuous improvement for month close processes across FGBS teams. We own developing automation to scale with Amazon’s growth, reduce manual effort and defects, streamline processes, and drive accountability across teams. The Close Systems team improves the financial close by developing automation to scale with Amazon’s growth, reduce manual effort and defects, streamline processes, and drive accountability across teams.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. descriptionHtml:
This role is for one of the Weekday's clients

Salary range: Rs 2000000 - Rs 3500000 (ie INR 20-35 LPA)

Min Experience: 4+ years

Location: Bengaluru

JobType: full-time

You will operate at the crossroads of academic complexity and user-friendly product design, converting the requirements of administrators, faculty, and students into features that truly revolutionize institutional operations. You will work in close collaboration with teams from engineering, design, customer success, and sales to create a product that connects with institutions throughout India and internationally.

Requirements

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Take full ownership of and continuously enhance the product roadmap for the Academics vertical, encompassing aspects such as attendance, timetabling, curriculum management, course registration, class creation, LMS, feedback, surveys, and PhD/research modules
  • Prioritize features and improvements by integrating customer feedback, usage analytics, and current higher education institutional trends
  • Effectively balance immediate customer demands with the long-term vision for the platform, ensuring that all decisions support our growth goals
  • Lead regular discovery sessions with academic administrators, faculty members, and students from partner institutions to identify pain points and unmet requirements
  • Evaluate product usage data, support inquiries, and market insights to uncover gaps and new opportunities for products within the academics vertical
  • Collaborate closely with customer success and sales teams to incorporate the customer's perspective into every sprint and planning session
  • Convert complex academic workflows into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and user stories that engineering and design teams can confidently implement
  • Facilitate agile processes including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives to ensure timely delivery of high-quality releases
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts across design, engineering, QA, and go-to-market teams to guarantee smooth launches of new features
  • Track adoption, engagement, and outcome metrics following product launches and rapidly iterate based on data and user feedback
  • Maintain a well-organized product backlog, prioritizing tasks that have the greatest impact
  • Serve as the main product liaison for academic module stakeholders, both internally (sales, customer success, engineering) and externally (institutional administrators and faculty)
  • Consistently communicate product progress, roadmap priorities, and release schedules clearly to leadership and cross-functional team members

Requirements

Must Haves

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in product management within enterprise SaaS or education technology, with a proven history of delivering B2B SaaS products from start to finish
  • Demonstrated capability to independently manage a product vertical—from initial discovery and roadmap development through execution and post-launch refinement
  • Deep understanding of academic workflows in higher education, including timetabling, curriculum management, learning management systems, attendance, and student lifecycle processes
  • Strong data-driven decision-making skills, comfortable utilizing product analytics tools and translating data into actionable product enhancements
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to align cross-functional teams around a unified product vision
  • Practical experience working in agile environments, conducting sprint ceremonies, and managing product backlogs

Good to Have

  • Previous experience collaborating with Indian higher education institutions such as universities, deemed universities, or autonomous colleges
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms like Moodle, Canvas, or proprietary systems, as well as academic ERP solutions
  • Experience using product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or equivalents
  • Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Figma
  • Background in working with customer-facing teams—including sales, support, and customer success—to collect and act upon institutional feedback
  • A passion for the education sector and a sincere interest in enhancing outcomes for students and academic institutions

Must-have Skills

Product Manager, Product Roadmapping, SaaS

Good-to-have Skills

B2B, LMS, ERP

Sequence regional coverage. Wallet, custody & blockchain depth. WHO WE ARE

MAI Labs is a Web3-native incubator. Our work sits inside the portfolio companies - STOEX (tokenised real-world asset marketplace, institutional buyers) and Kalp DLT (permissioned enterprise blockchain) and focus of this role is on Tresori (Non-custodial wallet layer with MPC security and multichain abstraction). Each portfolio company runs as an independent product with its own roadmap and go-to-market.


ROLE

You are the senior product voice for the wallet, stablecoin payments, and enterprise blockchain surface - owning strategy, roadmap, and execution across Tresori, and CorpCash. You will define what gets built, sequence it against real enterprise, developer, and regional demand, and hold the discipline that turns roadmap into shipped infrastructure. The role demands deep Web3 domain depth, sharp analytical instincts, and a builder track record at scale. Capital-disciplined by design: ruthless prioritisation, falsifiable bets, no scope theatre.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Product strategy & roadmap. Own end-to-end vision, roadmap, and delivery across Tresori (non-custodial wallet, MPC custody, multi-chain abstraction), with Kalp DLT as infra layer (enterprise blockchain).
  • Stablecoin payments & treasury product. Define product against real enterprise payment and treasury workflows with gateway integration, stablecoin rails, on/off-ramp partner sets, settlement timing, reconciliation, controls, and audit posture. Sequence regional coverage.
  • Wallet, custody & blockchain depth. Own the Tresori product surfaces end-to-end - MPC key management, signing flows, multi-chain account abstraction, recovery models, developer-facing APIs, and chain-level capabilities. Hold security and UX as one product problem, not two.
  • Architecture-grade product judgement. Own PRDs and partner deeply with engineering on system design, scalability, and protocol choices. Earn the right to call architecture-shaping product trade-offs - MPC vs multi-sig, on-chain vs off-chain settlement, chain abstraction depth, SDK surface.
  • Data-led execution & product culture. Lead product decisions through analytics, experimentation, and user behaviour insights. Define success metrics per surface - wallet retention, transaction volume, treasury throughput, developer activation.


CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 10+ years in product management with proven end-to-end ownership and measurable business impact across infrastructure, platform, or financial products.
  • Blockchain product depth. Real shipping experience in Web3 — wallets, custody, smart contracts, on-chain settlement, or enterprise chain deployment. Domain depth, not adjacent exposure.
  • Payment gateway experience. Built or owned a payments product end-to-end with gateway integration, settlement, on/off-ramps, reconciliation, controls. Stablecoin rails preferred.
  • Analytical and technical fluency. Strong data-led mindset with experimentation discipline. Technically fluent enough to debate distributed systems, key management, and architecture with engineering.
  • Operator in ambiguity. Track record in lean, pre-revenue, fast-moving settings. Not a profile sharpened only inside well-funded scale operations.


REPORTING

Reports to the CTO, with matrix engagement across portfolio company leaders.

Job Description: Sr. Manager – New Product Development (NPD) & Quality

Role: Senior Manager - Subject Matter Expert for Munchies & Snacks, Traditional Foods, Sweets, Chocolates-Confectionary, Breakfast cereals & Emerging Categories

Role Objective

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Manager – Product Development & Quality to lead end-to-end development and quality assurance across Snacking, Traditional Foods, Sweets, Breakfast Cereals, and Emerging Categories within our private label portfolio.

As the Sr. Manager – NPD & Quality, This role will serve as the technical backbone for product range expansion, transforming traditional flavors into scalable, high-quality offerings. This role bridges culinary expertise with food science, ensuring every product meets our highest standards of quality, safety, and consistency. Drive trend-led innovation while upholding world-class product quality and robust food safety standards across all categories.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Development & Innovation

End-to-End Development: Lead the formulation of a diverse portfolio including Namkeen, Extruded Snacks, Energy Bars, and Confectionary.

Traditional Modernization: Adapt Indian Sweets, Chikki, and Traditional Foods for modern retail without losing authentic "homemade" soul.

Clean Label Initiative: Work to reduce artificial additives, moving toward natural preservatives in Chutneys and Spreads.

Health & Wellness: Drive innovation in Emerging Categories like high-protein Energy Bars, Clean-Label Spreads, and Whole-Grain Breakfast Cereals.

Develop and optimize recipes/formulations aligned to target cost, quality, and shelf-life

Drive innovation based on market trends, competitor benchmarking, and consumer insights

Conduct trials (lab & plant scale) and ensure successful commercialization

  • Quality Assurance & Standardization

Define product specifications, SOPs, and quality benchmarks for all SKUs

Establish sensory, physical, and microbiological quality parameters

Conduct supplier audits, product evaluations, and ensure batch-to-batch consistency

Implement quality improvement initiatives and root cause analysis for deviations

  • Supplier Management & Capability Building

Identify, Audit, onboard, and develop suppliers/vendors

Work closely with manufacturers to ensure adherence to product specs and process controls

Drive vendor performance through audits, scorecards, and continuous improvement plans

  • Regulatory & Compliance

Ensure compliance with FSSAI and other applicable food safety standards

Validate label claims, nutritional information, and ingredient declarations

Support regulatory documentation and approvals for new product launches

  • Cost Optimization & Productivity

Drive value engineering initiatives without compromising quality

Optimize formulations, ingredients, and processes to meet cost targets

Support scale-up efficiency and wastage reduction initiatives

  • Cross-functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Operations for seamless launches

Align with packaging and logistics teams for shelf-life and stability considerations

Support customer feedback analysis and continuous product improvement.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strategic Product Development: Ability to build and drive NPD pipeline across categories, translating consumer insights and traditional recipes into scalable, commercially viable products.

Food Science & Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of ingredients, processing technologies, shelf-life, and formulation across snacks, sweets, and cereals.

Quality & Food Safety Leadership: Deep knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP/GHP with the ability to establish robust quality systems and ensure compliance across vendors.

Scale-up & Commercialization: Proven capability in moving products from lab to plant scale, ensuring consistency, efficiency, and speed-to-market.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management: Strong experience in vendor development, audits, and cross-functional collaboration (Procurement, Ops, Marketing, Supply Chain).

Cost Optimization & Value Engineering: Ability to balance cost, quality, and performance through formulation and process optimization.

Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving: Strong root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement mindset.

Innovation & Market Orientation: Ability to identify trends, benchmark competition, and drive differentiated product offerings.

Leadership & Team Management: Capability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive accountability across functions and partners.

Execution Excellence: High ownership with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Travel requirement

This role requires extensive travel (~20–30%) across multiple cities and supplier locations.

Travel will be primarily for product development trials, plant validations, supplier onboarding, audits, and quality alignment.

The candidate should be comfortable working closely with manufacturing partners on-site to drive faster commercialization and consistent quality execution.

Qualifications & Experience

B.Tech / M.Tech in Food Technology/ Food Science with 10 years in R&D/NPD and Quality Assurance within the FMCG or Food Retail sector.

Experience In FMCG, QSR, Or Private Label Business Preferred

Ability to balance "the best recipe" with "the best COGS" (Cost of Goods Sold).

Be part of a team where your work takes center stage, shaping the future of software development. At JFrog, we solve critical challenges for leaders like Amazon, Google, and Netflix.   • "As a developer, seeing your products on the biggest Tech event stages twice a year is WOW."

What you’ll be doing as a Senior Product Manager :

What You Bring On To The Table

  • 12+ years of industry experience with minimum 6+ years of Product Management experience in the Tech Product / SaaS industry
  • Proven success working on large-scale products with thousands of customers.

About JFrog

JFrog is the only end-to-end software supply chain platform that provides complete visibility, security, and control for automating the delivery of trusted releases from code to production. Our platform enables organizations to manage, secure, and automate their software delivery process, fueling innovation without worry. We empower companies to build and release software faster and more securely than ever before.

With over 7,500 customers worldwide, including many Fortune 100 companies, JFrog is at the forefront of global innovation. Join us in shaping the future of software delivery and contributing to solutions that empower some of the world's most influential industries.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

We are building a secure, compliant, and highly reliable healthcare data platform that transports and transforms clinical and operational data from hospital on‑premises environments to the cloud. As a Sr. Staff Technical Product Owner, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and outcomes for end‑to‑end data movement, interoperability, and governance—working across global product managers in multiple healthcare sub‑segments to deliver interoperable, scalable, and cost‑efficient data capabilities.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Own vision & roadmap
    • Translate organizational strategy into a platform‑level multi‑release roadmap with clear value milestones and measurable outcomes.
    • Continuously capture Voice of Customer (VoC) from catching programs and adjust prioritization and scope to maximize impact.
  • Backlog leadership
    • Author and maintain Epics, Features, and User Stories with acceptance criteria; ensure traceability to business outcomes and regulatory/compliance needs.
    • Lead backlog grooming, PI planning, and cross‑program dependency management (SAFe or equivalent).
  • Bridge product & engineering
    • Act as the primary interface between global product managers and engineering leads, ensuring scope clarity, non‑functional requirements (performance, reliability, security), and delivery quality.
    • Drive design‑to‑value decisions across ingestion, streaming, API exposure, and data storage layers in future.
  • Healthcare interoperability & data standards
    • Define patterns for HL7 v2.x, FHIR - Mapping/translation
    • Guide implementation choices for integration engines (e.g., Mirth/NextGen Connect, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody) and schema governance.
  • Secure & compliant data movement (on‑prem → cloud)
    • Own product requirements for connectivity (AWS Direct Connect, Site‑to‑Site VPN, SD‑WAN, private links), data in motion (TLS 1.2/1.3, mTLS, certificate rotation), and data at rest (KMS/HSM encryption, key rotation).
    • Define AuthN/AuthZ strategies (OIDC/OAuth2, SAML, RBAC/ABAC, least privilege) and secrets management.
    • Ensure adherence to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regional privacy laws (e.g., GDPR).
  • Streaming & data platform architecture
    • Shape the streaming roadmap using Kafka (brokers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, schema registry, Avro/Protobuf), Kafka Connect, and CDC pipelines or any similar technology
    • Partner with architects on scalable ingestion, schema evolution, replay, dead‑letter handling, and observability (OpenTelemetry, metrics, tracing, logs).
  • AWS platform delivery
    • Define requirements and guardrails for AWS services such as S3, MSK (or self‑managed Kafka), Glue, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, PrivateLink, CloudWatch, KMS, Secrets Manager.
    • Drive reliability goals (SLOs/SLAs, RTO/RPO), disaster recovery patterns, and multi‑account/multi‑region design as needed.
  • Cloud cost optimization (FinOps)
    • Lead cost‑to‑serve modeling and reduction initiatives: right‑sizing, instance families compression/partitioning, autoscaling, and data egress minimization.
    • Establish cost dashboards, budgets, and per‑feature cost accountability.
  • Cybersecurity & privacy
    • Stay current with cybersecurity best practices (zero‑trust, network segmentation, vulnerability management, threat modelling, security testing, SBOM where applicable).
    • Champion privacy‑by‑design, data minimization, de‑identification/pseudonymization where appropriate.
What You’ll Bring (Required Qualifications)

  • Experience: 12–15+ years in product management/ownership or platform leadership, with 5+ years focused on data platforms/streaming and 3+ years in healthcare data interoperability.
  • Deep technical fluency in:
    • Streaming with Kafka (clusters, partitioning strategy, throughput/latency tuning, schema registry).
    • Data security: encryption at rest/in transit, AuthN/AuthZ (OIDC/OAuth2/SAML), RBAC/ABAC, secrets management.
    • AWS core data & networking services; secure connectivity from on‑prem to cloud (Direct Connect, VPN, private connectivity).
    • Cybersecurity controls and compliance frameworks relevant to healthcare (HIPAA/HITRUST/SOC 2).
  • Healthcare standards: hands‑on with HL7 v2, FHIR
  • Roadmap & execution: proven track record translating vision into incremental deliveries; ownership of Epics/Features/Stories and measurable outcomes.
  • Cross‑functional leadership: success aligning multiple global product managers and engineering teams in a highly dynamic environment.
  • Cloud cost reduction: demonstrable wins lowering run‑rate and egress costs, optimizing storage/compute, and implementing FinOps practices.
  • Communication: excellent written/verbal skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and vice‑versa.
  • Hands on experience in Product Management using Gen AI tooling
Nice To Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with integration engines (e.g., Mirth/NextGen Connect, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody), and EMR/vendor ecosystems (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, Meditech, etc.).
  • Knowledge of data governance & cataloguing (e.g., AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog), lineage, DQ frameworks, and PHI/PII handling patterns.
  • Familiarity with event‑driven and API‑first architectures (REST/gRPC), Idempotency, Exactly‑once/At‑least‑once semantics.
  • Observability tooling (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk,Promethesu, Graffana) and SRE practices (error budgets, SLOs).

Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

descriptionHtml:
Why should you choose us?

Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry’s pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security.


Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https://symphony.rakuten.com.


Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan’s newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global.


To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.


Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together!


About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.


About the Role

We're looking for an experienced, product-first thinker to own the end-to-end design, build, and delivery of an AI-native Operations Support System (OSS) platform that drives intelligent automation across complex operational environments. You will shape a product that moves customers along the journey toward Autonomous Networks Level 4 (AN4) — enabling highly autonomous, self-healing, and self-optimizing operations powered by Closed-Loop Automation (CLA) and Generative AI.

This role demands strong product instincts, a command of modern product frameworks, and the ability to translate operational complexity into elegant, scalable software.


Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Build and own a product roadmap grounded in structured discovery: Jobs-to-be-Done, outcome-driven frameworks, and continuous customer evidence.
  • Define clear problem statements, opportunity hypotheses, and measurable success metrics (OKRs, KPIs) for every initiative.
  • Create compelling business cases with explicit ROI, adoption, and value-realization criteria.
  • Identify market opportunities across enterprise operations, managed services, and infrastructure markets; drive positioning and GTM strategy.

Product Build & Execution

  • Lead agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives) with a bias toward continuous delivery and validated learning.
  • Write sharp, unambiguous PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — bridging operator workflows and engineering implementation.
  • Drive product decisions with data: usage telemetry, funnel metrics, and A/B testing where applicable.
  • Manage cross-product dependencies and integration points across the OSS portfolio.

AI, Closed-Loop Automation & Autonomous Operations

  • Define and prioritize AI/ML features including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, intelligent decisioning, and GenAI-assisted workflows.
  • Own the product vision for Closed-Loop Automation (CLA) capabilities — from event detection and root-cause analysis through automated remediation and feedback.
  • Translate the AN4 autonomy maturity model into a concrete product roadmap: moving customers from human-assisted (L2) through human-delegated (L3) to highly autonomous (L4) operations.
  • Work with data science and ML teams to define training data requirements, model evaluation criteria, and responsible AI guardrails.

Go-to-Market & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Design and implement pricing strategies: tiered licensing, consumption-based SaaS, and value-based models.
  • Collaborate with Sales to develop value propositions, competitive differentiation, and sales enablement materials (battle cards, solution briefs).
  • Drive alignment across Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support.
  • Communicate product vision with strong storytelling — simplifying complex automation and AI concepts for business stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree from a Tier-1 institution, or equivalent demonstrated impact.
  • 8 – 12 years of Product Management experience in B2B enterprise software; OSS, operations automation, or infrastructure management strongly preferred.
  • Deep command of modern product frameworks: Continuous Discovery, Shape Up, Jobs-to-be-Done, Lean Product, or equivalent.
  • Proven experience shipping and scaling mature SaaS products, not just roadmap planning.
  • Hands-on understanding of operational workflows: fault management, configuration management, performance assurance, or service orchestration.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML product development cycles — from use-case ideation through model deployment and feedback loops.
  • Strong understanding of Closed-Loop Automation (CLA) principles and how they apply to real-time operational systems.
  • Familiarity with Autonomous Networks concepts (TM Forum AN framework, L0–L5 maturity) is a strong plus.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to operate at both executive vision level and engineering detail level.
  • Hands-on with Jira, Confluence, Figma, and data/analytics tooling.


Skills

Primary Skills

  • Product Ownership & Outcome-Driven Management.
  • AI/ML Use-case Ideation, Prioritization & Delivery.
  • Closed-Loop Automation (CLA) Product Design.
  • Autonomous Operations / AN4 Roadmapping.
  • SaaS Product Development & Continuous Delivery.
  • Agile Methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Shape Up).
  • Stakeholder Management & Executive Communication.
  • Requirements Elicitation, PRD Writing & Documentation.


Secondary Skills

  • Data Analysis & Product Metrics.
  • Market Research & Competitive Intelligence.
  • UI/UX Principles & Prototyping (Figma).
  • Public Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • API-first & Microservices Architecture Awareness.


RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES:

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviours that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

  • Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.
  • Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.
  • Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.
  • Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.
  • Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

Job Description

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Digital Product Manager, Solutions UI L2 product area within Workplace Services and Automation to lead end-to-product strategy, delivery, and lifecycle management of critical digital platforms used by employees across the enterprise, with direct accountability for guiding senior software development teams delivering these products.

In This Role, You Will

  • Act as an advisor to senior leadership to develop or influence digital products, initiatives, plans, specifications, resources, and long-term goals for highly complex business and technical needs across a functional area within the Digital environment
  • Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise
  • Deliver solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
  • Coordinate highly complex activities and guidance to others
  • Provide vision, direction and expertise to senior leadership on implementing innovative and significant digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have significant impact
  • Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise
  • Serve as an expert advisor to leadership

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in digital product management or closely related roles
  • Proven experience owning and scaling enterprise-grade digital platforms or employee-facing technology digital products, platforms or software products
  • Strong experience working with senior software engineers and development teams in building complex, distributed systems
  • Solid understanding of:
    • Modern software architecture (cloud-native, APIs, integrations, automation)
    • SDLC, CI/CD, quality engineering, and reliability practices
  • Ability to engage deeply in technical discussions and make informed trade-off decisions (without being a hands-on coder)
  • Demonstrated leadership in large, complex digital transformation programs
  • Strong leadership experience in large, complex digital transformation initiatives
  • Deep understanding of Agile and product operating models, including backlog management and delivery at scale
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams on software platforms, integrations, APIs, and automation
  • Strong data-driven decision-making skills, including use of metrics, analytics, and ROI to prioritize work
  • Excellent communication and executive-level storytelling skills
  • Ability to operate effectively across business, technology, design, and risk functions
  • Experience in Workplace Technology, End-User Computing, Productivity Platforms, or Enterprise Automation
  • Expertise in Scaled Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe, Nexus) and agile portfolio management
  • Strong understanding of API-led architectures, platform strategy, and automation
  • Experience operating in large, regulated environments with strong risk and compliance expectations
  • Familiarity with data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
  • Exposure to Design Thinking, Lean UX, and customer experience practices
  • Advanced certifications:
    • SAFe certifications
    • Product Management or Digital Transformation certifications
  • Executive education in product strategy or digital leadership
  • Bachelor's degree in technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Job Expectations:

  • Act as a senior advisor to executive leadership, shaping long-term digital product strategy, backlog, roadmaps, and investment priorities
  • Own enterprise-scale digital products end-to-end, including vision, strategy, roadmap, backlog, delivery, and outcomes
  • Serve as Product Owner for assigned Level-2 enterprise products
  • Define product success metrics, outcomes, and value realization aligned to business strategy
  • Lead and influence senior and lead software development teams responsible for designing, building, and scaling digital products
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Lead Engineers to ensure:
    • Sound technical design and architecture
    • Scalable, secure, and resilient solutions
    • Alignment to enterprise engineering standards and patterns
  • Translate complex business problems into clear technical and functional requirements
  • Provide product and technical clarity to teams operating in agile delivery models
  • Lead resolution of highly complex, ambiguous business and technology challenges spanning multiple domains
  • Drive large-scale digital transformation initiatives, including automation and platform modernization
  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized backlogs
  • Partner with Technology, XD, Automation, and Architecture teams to deliver secure, scalable, and compliant solutions
  • Influence across lines of business and senior stakeholders without formal authority
  • Balance value, risk, compliance, and technical feasibility in product decisions and ensure alignment with risk, compliance, and regulatory expectations
  • Provide thought leadership and direction on enterprise product management practices, agile ways of working, and portfolio management
  • Drive execution using Agile and scaled Agile frameworks, ensuring predictable delivery and quality outcomes
  • Balance features, technical debt, platform modernization, security, and compliance in prioritization decisions
  • Lead resolution of highly complex, ambiguous challenges spanning business and technology domains
Posting End Date:

16 Jun 2026

  • Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit's risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

Applicants With Disabilities

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo .

Drug and Alcohol Policy

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

Wells Fargo Recruitment And Hiring Requirements

  • Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.
  • Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

QAD's AI Platform is the domain intelligence layer that sits between the ERP and autonomous AI agents. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable — transforming QAD from a system of record into a system of action.

Job Description

This role owns the full product lifecycle for QAD's Copilot, Search, and Conversational Analytics capabilities — from architecture through to market launch. You will define what gets built, why it matters to manufacturing users, and how it reaches them: shaping the product vision, driving engineering delivery, and partnering with GTM to ensure adoption.

The intelligence that powers these surfaces — how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how data is retrieved, and how responses are generated — is where QAD's AI moat is built. You will need to engage deeply with these layers, not as an engineer but as the product owner who defines the contracts, quality standards, and sequencing decisions that determine whether they work in production at enterprise scale.

You will report to the Head of Platform Product, with day-to-day direction from the Director of the AI Platform org. This role is evaluated through the quality of your product thinking, your influence on engineering direction, and the outcomes you drive in the market.

The Opportunity

Manufacturing users today cannot query their own operations without analysts, BI tools, or pre-built reports. QAD's AI platform changes this — but only if the Copilot and Search layer is built correctly and lands with users. You will own both sides of that equation.

  • Define the semantic search and conversational analytics product that allows manufacturing users to query operational data — orders, inventory, suppliers, quality records — in natural language, without SQL or BI expertise
  • Own the intelligence contract: how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how retrieval is orchestrated, and how responses are grounded in governed data — the foundational decisions that determine product quality at scale
  • Drive the Copilot from concept to customer — including the contextual layer architecture, the grounding contract against the platform's Semantic Layer, and the GTM motion that gets it adopted in manufacturing workflows
  • Build the feedback loops that make the product smarter over time: how recurring query patterns surface ontology gaps, how session analytics drive prioritisation, and how discovery findings translate into product improvements
  • Establish QAD's conversational analytics presence in market — working with GTM to define positioning, enablement, and the narrative that differentiates QAD's intelligence layer from horizontal AI tools

Key Responsibilities

Copilot & Conversational Analytics

  • Own the product definition for QAD's Copilot: how queries are understood, context assembled, data retrieved, and responses generated — specifying the contracts that engineering builds against
  • Define the grounding contract: the rules that ensure every Copilot response cites governed manufacturing data, not hallucinated inference — including confidence signalling and graceful fallback behaviour
  • Drive the conversational analytics strategy: how natural language queries translate into analytical results across manufacturing data domains without exposing SQL or BI complexity to the user
  • Specify the disambiguation model: how the Copilot handles ambiguous queries, missing context, and conflicting data signals in real manufacturing workflows

Search

  • Own the product definition for QAD's semantic search layer: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking, and result structure across manufacturing data domains
  • Define the search intent taxonomy — operational (find order, trace shipment), analytical (show trends, compare periods), and diagnostic (why is this delayed, what caused this variance) — and specify result formats by intent type
  • Drive the federated search architecture: how results from ERP operational data, analytical stores, and the knowledge graph are ranked and merged into a coherent, useful response

Discovery, Delivery & GTM

  • Maintain a structured customer discovery programme — extracting real manufacturing query patterns and translating findings into specific product and architecture implications
  • Own the product backlog: writing stories to Staff Engineer level of specificity — API contracts, state machines, data flows, edge cases — that engineering can build without verbal clarification
  • Partner with GTM to define the launch and adoption strategy for Copilot and Search: positioning, sales enablement, onboarding playbooks, and the narrative that lands with manufacturing buyers
  • Define the quality framework for these surfaces: what signals matter for product performance — retrieval relevance, grounding rate, latency distribution — and how they inform roadmap decisions

Stakeholder Management & Managing Up

  • Proactively surface dependencies, risks, and scope changes to the Director and Head of Platform Product — with a resolution proposal, not just an escalation
  • Communicate product and architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders — translating trade-offs into business implications without jargon
  • Build credibility with Engineering, Architecture, and GTM through the quality and precision of written work

Qualifications

Product Experience

  • 7–12 years in product management, with significant time owning AI-powered, search, or analytics products in enterprise B2B environments — from definition through production launch
  • Proven track record owning the full product lifecycle: customer discovery, specification, engineering delivery, and GTM — not just one slice
  • Experience working in matrixed organisations — driving outcomes across Platform, Engineering, Architecture, and GTM without direct authority
  • Evidence of structured discovery practice applied to a technical product surface — ability to extract product implications from user research, not just UX insights

Core Technical Depth — Required

These are the primary technical domains this role owns. Strong command is expected from day one.

  • Semantic search architecture: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking models, and relevance evaluation at enterprise scale
  • Conversational AI product design: how natural language queries are translated into structured analytical results across complex, domain-specific data without exposing backend complexity to users
  • LLM-integrated product specification: grounding strategies, hallucination mitigation, response quality gates, and context window management — sufficient to define product contracts engineering builds against
  • Data platform fluency: OLAP vs operational DB reads, federated search across heterogeneous stores, and how data freshness constraints affect product quality — sufficient to hold authoritative conversations with data engineers
  • SQL and data modelling: sufficient to validate query plans, understand schema implications, and reason through retrieval architecture trade-offs

Working Familiarity — Expected to Grow Into

These domains sit in adjacent platform layers that Copilot and Search consume. Deep expertise is not required on day one, but working fluency is expected — and will expand as the platform scales toward agentic capabilities.

  • Intent detection and query understanding pipelines: how user inputs are parsed, classified, and routed across platform layers
  • Context assembly and packaging: how metric definitions, entity relationships, and business rules are structured and passed downstream at inference time
  • Session and state management: conversation continuity, context windowing across multi-turn interactions, and memory summarisation patterns
  • Human-in-the-loop design: approval workflows, confidence thresholds, and escalation paths where AI-generated outputs require human validation before action

Competency Expectations

This role is calibrated to a Staff PM equivalent. Across QAD's four PM competency pillars:

  • Product Execution — Expert: Feature specification to Staff Engineer fidelity, end-to-end delivery ownership, and AI-specific quality gates (grounding rate, retrieval relevance, latency SLAs)
  • Customer Insight — Expert: Translates discovery and usage data into product decisions. Understands that conversational UX quality is determined by the intelligence layer beneath it
  • Product Strategy — Expert on vision and roadmapping; Intermediate on strategic impact, with a clear growth path toward Advanced as the platform scales
  • Influencing People — Intermediate on stakeholder management and managing up, growing toward Advanced. No people management expectation; growth path is toward leading a TPO as the surface scales

Behavioural Signals — Critical

  • Writes first, asks second — produces a concrete proposal or spec draft before escalating ambiguity
  • Distinguishes clearly between what is known, assumed, and needs validation — and acts accordingly
  • Comfortable operating without a playbook — defines the approach in novel problem spaces
  • Gravitates toward precision in language and specification — understands that ambiguous requirements are a form of technical debt

Manufacturing Or ERP Context — Preferred

  • Familiarity with manufacturing ERP data models (inventory, orders, procurement, quality) is a strong plus; not required if technical depth and learning velocity are demonstrated
  • Experience with operational analytics or supply chain intelligence products is valued, especially where the product involved translating domain-specific data into natural language interfaces

Additional Information

  • End-to-end ownership: You define what gets built and ensure it lands — from intelligence layer architecture to GTM motion and customer adoption
  • High-leverage surface: Copilot and Search are the primary interface through which manufacturing users experience QAD's AI platform. The decisions you make here compound across the platform
  • Technical depth valued: Specification quality is the primary currency of influence in this environment. Strong product thinking is recognised and rewarded
  • Growth trajectory: Clear path from Staff PM to broader intelligence surface ownership — including deeper agentic platform exposure — and over time, a small team
  • Pune platform hub: QAD is actively expanding its platform engineering and product capabilities in India — you will be a founding voice in that growth

About QAD

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

descriptionHtml:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience designing and implementing automated evals, with new products with limited users and datasets.
  • Experience building and expanding the productivity software (e.g. Google Workspace), with an understanding of market drivers and user needs.
  • Experience in expanding the AI technologies and APIs along with knowledge in AI/ML.
  • Experience managing product road maps and executing complex launches.
  • Understanding of search technologies, ranking algorithms, indexing, and search and engagement metrics, how to apply them to guide product development.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate direction, influence stakeholders at all levels, and navigate complex organizational landscapes.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

As a Product Manager in Workspace Search, you will own the direction, strategy, and execution for critical Search products for billions of users. You will build new search offerings to improve search quality for human users and expand the Search for agentic users, enabling them to retrieve and utilize Workspace data. You will drive significant impact and shape the search experience for billions of Workspace users globally. You will work at the intersection of Search and AI, defining how intelligent systems convert information to action for users and collaborate with technology to solve challenging problems.

If you are passionate about Search and eager to build the future of information retrieval in the age of AI, we would love to hear from you!

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the product lifecycle for search within Workspace apps. Identify opportunities and deliver features to improve search quality and enhance the user experience across existing and emerging surfaces, including Generative AI features.
  • Develop and launch the API offering to provide agents with effective access to Workspace search results, unlocking new use cases and integrations.
  • Institute the processes for experimentation, evaluation, and iteration on search quality, leveraging user feedback, data analysis, and A/B testing. Drive the strategy and implementation of automated evaluation frameworks, particularly for novel search scenarios and greenfield projects, to ensure consistent quality and velocity.
  • Define and track key search success metrics to inform product decisions, measure impact, and communicate progress. Collaborate and influence a wide range of cross-functional teams, including Engineering, UX, Research, Marketing, and Leadership, to build consensus and drive execution.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

As a Digital Product Leader at Azentio, you will drive the end-to-end digital vision and strategy across our Banking and Financial Services product portfolio. This role goes beyond individual solutions—you will lead the development of scalable, platform-first digital ecosystems, enabling seamless and customer-centric experiences across web and mobile.

You will combine strategic leadership, platform thinking, and deep BFSI domain expertise to build future-ready digital products that are modular, extensible, and aligned with evolving market needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the digital product vision and roadmap across BFS products, ensuring alignment with overall business strategy and market opportunities
  • Lead the development of platform-driven digital products, including customer portals, mobile apps, and enterprise-grade digital ecosystems across B2C, B2B2C, and broker channels
  • Drive a platform-first approach, ensuring reusable components, APIs, and scalable architecture across products
  • Own product lifecycle management—from ideation to launch and continuous enhancement
  • Prioritize and manage product backlogs, balancing customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility
  • Partner with UX/UI, engineering, marketing, and sales teams to deliver intuitive, seamless customer journeys
  • Embed Agile practices to deliver high-quality outcomes with speed and predictability
  • Manage senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to drive alignment and adoption of the digital strategy
  • Leverage data, analytics, and customer insights to continuously optimize product performance and user experience

Required Experience & Skills

  • 15+ years of experience in product management, with strong exposure to digital platforms in Banking, Financial Services, or Insurance (BFSI)
  • Strong experience in a platform-first/product platform development approach, including:
  • Designing and building scalable, modular platforms
  • Driving API-first / microservices-based architecture
  • Enabling reuse, extensibility, and ecosystem integration
  • Proven experience in building and scaling enterprise digital platforms (web & mobile)
  • Demonstrated ability to define platform strategy, including underlying architecture, integrations, and product ecosystem design
  • Expertise in designing and optimizing multi-channel customer journeys (B2C, B2B2C, broker channels)
  • Strong understanding of UX/UI principles and close collaboration with design teams
  • Experience with design and collaboration tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, InVision, Miro, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Canva
  • Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and tools like Jira, Confluence, or Trello
  • Strong strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills
