From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About The Role

As a Staff Product Manager , you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of the strategy for building new connectors using AI and manage a portfolio of connectors that drive growth of Fivetran

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive the roadmap for the future of Fivetran’s API connector development including leveraging AI to auto-generate connectors
  • Manage the product roadmap & backlog for the Lite connector portfolio by balancing new connector development, and adding new features to existing connectors.
  • Perform in-depth data analysis and customer research to identify areas of opportunity for improvements
  • Partner with & lead cross-functional teams across various functions to execute the product roadmap
  • Establish and oversee the tracking of various product health metrics, ensuring that the connectors remain well-aligned with customer requirements & Fivetran’s product principles.
  • Evangelize the success of your initiatives both internally and externally


Skills We’re Looking For

  • Track record of shipping SaaS products that deliver measurable results
  • Experience leveraging LLMs for a variety of tasks
  • Ability to translate complex details into clear, concise requirements and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A deep sense of empathy for the customer, ensuring that all solutions are customer-focused and deliver significant value
  • Strong attention to detail with a deep understanding of the big picture
  • Ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines
  • Demonstrated use of analytics, user research, and business cases to drive decisions and improve products.
  • Embody our product team values of Curiosity, Ownership, Collaboration, Kindness, and Integrity.


Bonus Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL
  • Prior experience working with APIs such as managing API-driven products or managing integrations




Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
  • Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays, and volunteer days off
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities

title: Product Manager
description: About GleanGlean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. descriptionHtml:
About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About The Role

Glean is seeking a Product Manager who will play a pivotal role in realizing our vision: to become the most powerful AI assistant, delivering enterprise-contextualized intelligence, actioning, and support seamlessly across every workflow and environment. We're building best-in-class products that not only help users find, curate, share, and manage knowledge, but also proactively assist and take action—right where work happens. Join us as we shape the future of work by embedding Glean’s AI-driven capabilities into every corner of the modern enterprise experience.

We’re currently a very lean product team, so you’ll have an outsized role in shaping both the product roadmap and the product team itself. You’ll collaborate closely with our stellar Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Success partners to understand our customers and build category-defining tools. You’ll wear many hats and gain both breadth and depth of experience.

You Will

  • Spending a lot of time with our customers to deeply understand their knowledge needs
  • Developing key parts of our product roadmap, marrying customers’ needs with our product vision
  • Empowering your team by giving context, setting direction, and building alignment
  • Driving customer-focused decisions, clear prioritization, and efficient execution
  • Coordinating cross-functionally with with leadership, go-to-market teams, and other key stakeholders across the company
  • Building processes that will scale as our team and company go through rapid growth

About You

  • You have 6+ years of experience as a product manager at a B2B SaaS company. Experience working on collaboration, productivity, or ML/ranking tools is a plus.
  • You have a strong technical background and excel at analytical thinking
  • You are an excellent written and verbal communicator
  • You have a proven track record of taking ownership, taking initiative, and delivering results
  • You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners
  • You have a learning and growth mindset
  • You are mission-first and understand that your success is measured by your product and team’s success

Location:

  • This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

The Product Manager owns the vision, strategy, and roadmap for digital and AI-enabled products serving the Operations function. This role bridges business strategy and technology execution — defining what to build, why to build it, and how it delivers measurable value across the Operations value chain. The Product Manager works closely with Operations stakeholders, Data Scientists, and Engineering teams to ship impactful capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

 Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and own the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for AI and digital products within the Operations domain
  • Identify and prioritise product opportunities based on business impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment
  • Translate Operations pain points and opportunities into a coherent product strategy
  • Communicate roadmap and product direction to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams

Discovery & Backlog Management

  • Lead product discovery activities including user research, journey mapping, and opportunity assessment
  • Maintain a well-groomed, prioritised product backlog aligned to business value
  • Write clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with Business Analysts
  • Make prioritisation decisions based on data, stakeholder input, and strategic objectives

Delivery Collaboration

  • Act as the primary product authority within Agile delivery teams
  • Partner with Data Scientists to define AI product requirements, evaluate model outputs, and validate business value
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Architecture on technical feasibility and trade-offs
  • Drive sprint reviews, demos, and feedback cycles with Operations stakeholders

Outcomes & Performance

  • Define and track product KPIs and OKRs to measure adoption, efficiency gains, and business value realisation
  • Gather and synthesise post-launch feedback to inform iterative improvement
  • Champion a data-driven and user-centric product culture within the team

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise operations or supply chain systems
  • Proven ability to define product strategy, manage roadmaps, and drive end-to-end delivery
  • Strong experience with Agile methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence, Productboard)
  • Familiarity with AI/ML product development — understanding of model capabilities, limitations, and operationalisation
  • Experience with ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, D365) or supply chain management systems is advantageous
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills with ability to influence without authority

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Join Adobe’s Digital Experience organization in Bengaluru as a Product Manager 3 and lead one of our most important enterprise capabilities. You will manage forecasting within a connected ecosystem that includes Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, and upstream planning systems. This provides a single, reliable view of pipeline and ARR forecasts, which directly supports executive decision-making. This outstanding opportunity lets you join a world-class team and make a meaningful impact!

What You’ll Do

  • Take full responsibility for Sales Performance Management and forecasting systems from start to finish
  • Define product strategy and roadmap for pipeline visibility, forecast rollups, and data-based predictions
  • Lead cross-system integration and architecture, ensuring scalable, reliable data flows
  • Partner with Sales, RevOps, and Finance to align forecast definitions, pipeline stages, and revenue assumptions
  • Improve forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, and predictability through data insights
  • Work with engineering teams to bring to bear AI/ML, LLMs, or automation frameworks (e.g., copilots, agents, orchestration tools)
  • Proven capability to outline, convey, and secure agreement on multi-year product roadmaps for platform or enterprise products

Skills Required

  • 6–8 years in Product Management, ideally within Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, RevOps, or related platforms
  • Experience owning complex, multi-system enterprise products or SPM and Forecasting platforms
  • Strong comprehension of sales pipeline oversight, sales performance tracking, and forecasting procedures
  • Strong experience partnering with engineering, architecture, and operations teams in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience managing complex, multi-system initiatives through disciplined prioritization and execution
  • Strong data and analytical abilities with experience working on data models, pipelines, and forecasting inputs
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment and roadmap execution at scale

Requirements & Product Discovery

  • Strong ability to elicit, structure, and validate business requirements through interviews, workshops, and discovery sessions with collaborators, customers, and other interested parties
  • Experience conducting fit-gap analysis (current vs. future state) to define MVP scope and strategic roadmap
  • Ability to challenge and refine requirements to ensure alignment with business value, outcomes, and scalability

Documentation & Communication

  • Expertise in crafting clear, structured product artifacts, including:

Product Requirements Documents (PRDs)

  • Business Requirements Documents (BRDs)

Process flows, journey maps, and personas

  • Ability to detail end-to-end business processes and system interactions, including downstream impacts across coordinated platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Backlog Management & Delivery Readiness

  • Proven experience translating requirements into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Strong backlog ownership, including prioritization, refinement, and sprint readiness
  • Ability to outline test scenarios and UAT criteria, ensuring delivered features meet business expectations
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Workfront)

Cross-Functional Leadership & Alignment

  • Ability to lead and influence across Sales, RevOps, Finance, Engineering, and Architecture without direct authority
  • Experience driving alignment on scope, priorities, and definitions across complex collaborator groups
  • Comfortable presenting to and influencing senior leadership and governance forums (e.g., PRB/ARB)

Analytical & Problem-Solving

  • Strong capability to detect problems in data, process, or system build
  • Experience using data to drive product decisions, prioritization, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to recognize root causes of business and system challenges and convert them into actionable solutions

Execution & Operational Excellence

  • Experience managing products through full lifecycle (discovery → definition → delivery → release → optimization)
  • Strong focus on detail with the capability to handle dependencies, risks, and delivery schedules
  • Ability to balance run-the-business priorities with central initiatives

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015.

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

Analytical & Problem-Solving

  • Strong capability to detect problems in data, process, or system build

Execution & Operational Excellence

descriptionHtml:
About Us
QuillBot was founded in 2017 with a mission to help students and professionals strengthen their writing. Today, we help over 56 million people around the world create great things. Whether you're writing, designing, coding, or collaborating, QuillBot is a place where anyone can create at the speed of thought. Our AI-powered tools help you think clearly, communicate effectively, and create beautifully—across every platform, in any format, at any skill level. If you're passionate about using technology to make the path from inspiration to execution more accessible, intentional, and relevant, come join us.

Role Overview
Now we’re building a full AI-powered creation platform that supports them from the first spark of an idea to a finished, shareable piece of work.

The creation suite is a key pillar of this evolution, the space where users can transform their words into visually compelling assets: presentations, campaigns, PDFs, social posts, and more.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead this effort and shape the future of how people create with QuillBot.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the evolution of the creation suite from MVP to a flagship QuillBot product—driving the roadmap, success metrics, and user experience.
  • Own the end-to-end user journey for visual creation—from ideation to layout to export.
  • Partner with engineers, designers, marketing, brand, SEO and researchers to turn text and ideas into adaptive, multimodal outputs.
  • Define and validate workflows, templates, and design systems that make non-designers feel like creators.
  • Collaborate closely with the Writing and Chat product teams to ensure seamless handoffs between idea, draft, and design.
  • Use data, research, and product intuition to balance user delight, technical feasibility, and business impact.
  • Lead a cross-functional pod toward measurable outcomes—traffic, engagement, retention, and satisfaction.

Qualification 

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building/growing creation or design-centric products.
  • A track record of taking consumer-facing tools from 0→1 or 1→N, ideally with products in the creative or productivity space.
  • Experience in AI-assisted or automation-heavy workflows—text-to-image, auto-layout, or generative creation—is highly desirable.
  • Deep understanding of UX for creative tools and empathy for non-technical users.
  • Strong design sensibility—you understand layout, visual hierarchy, and what makes creation feel effortless.
  • Data-driven mindset; comfort working with analytics to inform decisions and measure success.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across design, engineering, marketing, and leadership.

What You Can Expect to Do in Your 180 Days

First 30 Days: Learn & Align

  • Deep-dive into QuillBot’s creation platform vision, user personas, and current MVP.
  • Understand the existing creation suite experience, performance metrics, and user pain points.
  • Conduct a competitive benchmarking.
  • Build strong partnerships with Design, Engineering, and AI/UX Research leads.
  • Align on near-term success metrics and team priorities.

30-90 Days: Define & Prioritize

  • Craft a clear roadmap for post-MVP development—defining which workflows, templates, and features matter most.
  • Lead early experiments in user experience, template expansion, and AI-assisted creation.
  • Establish analytics and feedback loops for measuring product success.
  • Partner with marketing and growth to position the creation suite within QuillBot’s ecosystem.

90–180 Days—Execute & Scale

  • Launch new workflows or features that significantly improve user creation speed and output quality.
  • Define and validate the long-term strategy for multimodal, brand-aware creation.
  • Drive engagement growth and user retention through data-backed iteration.
  • Build the foundation for QuillBot’s primary visual creation surface.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own one of the most impactful growth and experimentation surfaces at QuillBot.
  • Shape how millions of users discover and first experience QuillBot.
  • Work at the intersection of AI, growth, and product systems.
  • Collaborate with a team that values speed, learning, and thoughtful product decisions.
  • Be a key driver of QuillBot’s transition from individual tools to a cohesive creation platform.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Medical coverage
  • Life and accidental insurance
  • Vacation & leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
  • Developmental opportunities through education & developmental reimbursements & professional workshops
  • Maternity & parental leave
  • Hybrid & remote model with flexible working hours
  • On-site & remote company events throughout the year
  • Tech & WFH stipends & new hire allowances
  • Employee referral program
  • Premium access to QuillBot

*Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. We strongly encourage you to apply if you're interested: we'd love to learn how you can amplify our team with your unique experience!

This role is eligible for hire in India.

We are a virtual-first company with employees across the United States, Canada, India, Germany, and the Netherlands. Our compensation approach is market-based and varies by location while ensuring fairness, consistency, and transparency.

The base pay for this role is determined by several factors, including:

  • Relevant professional experience
  • Skills and expertise
  • Scope and responsibilities of the role
  • Internal equity considerations 

In addition to base salary, total compensation may include bonus, equity, and benefits. Eligibility depends on role, level, and location.

We are committed to equal pay for equal work, and all compensation decisions are made using consistent, gender-neutral criteria in alignment with pay transparency requirements

descriptionHtml:
Role description: This role is with one of our portfolio companies.


We are hiring a Lead Product Manager for one of our portfolio companies — a high-potential technology firm at a pivotal moment in its growth trajectory. This is the most senior product role within the organisation, and you will be accountable for defining the product vision, shaping the roadmap, and building the necessary discipline to take the company from early traction to significant, scalable impact.


This role offers a rare combination of high autonomy and high accountability. You will work closely with the founders, operate with lean processes, and exercise genuine ownership over product direction and outcomes.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap: Establish the product direction based on fundamental principles; translate business ambitions into a coherent roadmap with clear sequencing, trade-offs, and measurable milestones
  • AI-Native Product Development: Integrate AI meaningfully into core product workflows and user experiences from day one; this is an expectation, not an aspiration
  • Discovery & Problem Framing: Go beyond surface-level requirements; engage deeply with stakeholders to identify second and third-order problems and design solutions built for scalability
  • Enterprise & Integration Readiness: Drive API-first product thinking; understand the technical and security requirements of enterprise clients and build accordingly
  • Execution Ownership: Take full accountability from ideation through launch and iteration; the gap between strategy and delivery is yours to close
  • Team Building & Culture: Lead and develop a small, high-calibre product team; invest in hiring, mentoring, and establishing a culture of ownership and rigour
  • Act as a product evangelist within the organization, aligning stakeholders on product goals and strategies.


What We're Looking For:

Non-negotiables

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; an MBA from a Tier 1 institution is preferred
  • 8–12 years of progressive product management experience, with a minimum of 3–4 years in a role carrying full product ownership and strategic accountability
  • A proven track record in building 0-1 products, owning and executing product strategy throughout the entire product lifecycle, from inception to go-to-market.
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/ML into live products; conceptual familiarity is not sufficient
  • Deep understanding of B2B or B2B2C product dynamics — the ability to serve both enterprise buyers and end users with equal clarity
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments where the playbook does not yet exist
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — capable of effectively engaging with a founder, a CTO, and a junior PM


Strong Differentiators

  • Prior experience in regulated industries — including fintech, legaltech, insurtech, or similar domains
  • Exposure to API-first or platform product development
  • Experience with enterprise onboarding processes, integration complexities, or compliance-heavy product requirements
  • A track record of building product teams and establishing PM culture in early-stage environments


Note: We will check the fitment for multiple roles across our portfolios.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Lead Technical Product Owner (B4)

Position Description

Honeywell's Value Engineering (VE) and Component Engineering (CE) Center of Excellence (COE) is a dynamic collective of professionals dedicated to refining product development through innovative engineering and strategic component selection.

You will be part of Honeywell's VE/CE CoE Advanced Tech team driving Tech Charter & Strategy with focus on how AI/ML can enable us meet VE/CE revenue targets.

You will be driving requirements for AI solutions, outside-in product thinking, conceptualization, and feature scaling for solutions that improve product cost, component strategy, reuse, and business impact. You will own AI product enhancement and roadmap prioritization by partnering with engineering, VECE SMEs, and business stakeholders to convert user requirements into structured features and measurable value realization.

The role drives alignment across VECE, hardware engineering, and AI delivery teams, ensuring solutions are functionally relevant, technically feasible, and scalable across programs and product lines.

The ideal candidate brings 15+ years of experience, prior VECE program exposure, strong business understanding, and a hardware engineering foundation to shape high-impact AI product feature decisions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive end-to-end AI product requirements for VECE use cases by translating business priorities, user feedback, and engineering needs into clear functional requirements and product backlog items.
  • Bring an outside-in perspective to identify AI driven opportunities in value engineering, component optimization, reuse, and feature adoption that improve cost, quality, and business outcomes.
  • Lead AI product conceptualization and feature scaling for VECE-related solutions, ensuring alignment with user workflows, program priorities, and enterprise impact.
  • Prioritize AI enhancements and roadmap decisions based on value realization, implementation feasibility, business case strength, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Partner closely with VECE SMEs, hardware engineering teams, business stakeholders, and AI delivery teams to ensure solutions are relevant, scalable, and operationally effective.
  • Develop business and functional competency plans for delivery teams so they can better understand VECE processes, user pain points, and expected business outcomes.
  • Leverage prior VECE program experience to drive governance, stakeholder alignment, adoption, and continuous improvement across product features and delivery execution.

Skills

 QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of experience, including VECE program exposure, strong business acumen, and expertise in product requirements management.
  • Deep product ownership capability, including requirements shaping, feature definition, backlog prioritization, and roadmap decision-making across complex technical environments.
  • Strong VECE functional knowledge, with clear understanding of value engineering, component strategy, cost optimization, reuse opportunities, and business value realization.
  • Ability to translate business problems and user needs into structured functional requirements, scalable product concepts, and adoption-ready features.
  • Strong hardware engineering foundation to understand product architecture, technical feasibility, engineering constraints, and cross-functional trade-offs.
  • Excellent business acumen and outcome orientation, with the ability to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills to align VECE SMEs, engineering teams, business leaders, and AI delivery teams around common product goals.
  • Ability to build functional clarity and delivery readiness by enabling teams with domain context, governance discipline, and clear success measures for product adoption.

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group – Etch, we drive excellence in the design, development, and lifecycle management of Lam’s etch platforms and modules. The Etch Product Group is responsible for translating deep customer and market understanding into differentiated, scalable, and profitable products that solve the semiconductor industry’s most complex challenges.

The impact you’ll make

The Product Manager 4 (PM4) is the end‑to‑end business owner for one or more etch products, platforms, or major product families. This role owns product strategy, roadmap, Plan of Record (POR), and Whole Product delivery from concept through release and sustaining.

Operating with significant autonomy, the PM4 leads cross‑functional teams across engineering, operations, supply chain, quality, marketing, and customer support to deliver products that meet performance, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and supportability targets. The PM4 influences portfolio‑level decisions, manages complex tradeoffs, and serves as a senior product leadership voice within EPG.

What You’ll Do

  • Product Strategy, Vision & Roadmap Ownership
  • Own and evolve the product vision and multi‑year roadmap for assigned etch products or platforms, integrating customer needs, market dynamics, and technology direction.
  • Lead roadmap alignment discussions with engineering, marketing, operations, and executive stakeholders.
  • Translate strategy into clear success criteria, program vision, and prioritized investment decisions.
  • Plan of Record (POR) & Program Accountability
  • Author, communicate, and govern the Plan of Record (POR) for major programs, options, and sustaining initiatives.
  • Hold cross‑functional teams accountable to committed deliverables, milestones, cost targets, and performance objectives.
  • Manage tradeoffs explicitly, balancing speed, risk, cost, and long‑term product health.
  • End‑to‑End Product Lifecycle Ownership
  • Accountable for delivery of a Whole Product that is:
    • Qualified and meets customer performance targets
    • Released into manufacturing with predictable cost and lead time
    • Supportable in the field with complete documentation, training, and spares readiness
  • Own product definition in Product Option Architecture (POA) and approve product changes.
  • Govern unreleased product execution, including build plans, material readiness, and release gating.
  • Customer & Market Leadership

Who You'll Work With

You are someone who thrives in a high-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.

When you join us, you will have:

  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will own internal digital platforms and data platforms that shape how McKinsey communicates with and understands its audiences, both external and internal.

On the platform side, you will help shape the future of our internal digital experience, including transforming our internal microsite ecosystem. You will support internal clients in “citizen development” using AI tools to enable teams to build and manage their own sites, while reducing reliance on legacy platforms such as Drupal, and you will prototype solutions using modern AI-assisted development tools.

You will also own and shape key internal digital products that enable communication and engagement across McKinsey. You will own the Global Intranet homepage, our central hub for news, information, and tools used by thousands of colleagues each day. You will lead Firstup, our firm's internal employee engagement platform used by senior leaders and teams, to reach large audiences.

On the analytics side, you will build and manage the analytics and measurement capabilities, AI-powered tools, and self-serve reporting that help leaders across internal and external platforms understand what resonates, why it matters, and where to act. Across both, you will use GenAI not as a feature but as an operating model shift: prototyping solutions faster, automating recurring work and modernizing how internal sites are built and managed.

Across these efforts, you will partner with engineers, designers, data and analytics teams, and communications stakeholders to translate user needs into product requirements, drive adoption through change and training, and deliver impactful solutions in an agile, entrepreneurial environment.

You will be based in Gurugram as part of our Tech Ecosystem Reach & Engagement team. This team helps ensure that McKinsey enters its second century with a pre-eminent reputation: a private sector force for good as we accelerate sustainable and inclusive growth; a partner to our clients from idea to impact; a place that is both distinctive and inclusive, and an affirmatively global actor in a changing world — while engaging our recruits, colleagues, and alumni in our ambition.

Your Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 8+ years of experience building products with a strong product management toolkit across all aspects of product development lifecycle, leading cross-functional teams in agile set-up
  • 2+ years of experience managing consumer-grade web applications including API and data integrations, cloud hosting, testing, and deployment
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial mindset, with experience building, launching, or scaling new products or capabilities in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Experience applying AI/ML or data-driven approaches to solve product or business problems, with familiarity using modern AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, v0)
  • Experience with data engineering and analytics tools (e.g., AWS Glue, Snowflake, Power BI, Tableau)
  • Proficiency in Excel for budgeting, cost tracking, and forecasting & experience managing a large user base in a graceful, organized, and responsive way, including developing and delivering informal training and documentation
  • Ability to independently manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously, prioritizing effectively while staying mindful of the big picture & sensitivity with confidential information and adherence to the highest professional and process standards
  • Some flexibility in working hours is required to accommodate different time zones with ability to work partly in-person in our Gurugram office (team schedules may vary)
  • Experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders, translating data into decisions for leadership audiences & ability to engage an audience and create clear, logical, and structured communications across all formats, with fluent level language skills in English

descriptionHtml:
About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Team

The Product team is responsible for driving lead generation and management of leads. We do this by building innovative products & features that solve real-world problems for agencies and allow them to consolidate their offering to their clients in a single platform packaged under their white-labled brand.

The marketing products OS team focuses exclusively on products that can demonstrate lead generation and drive up engagement, adoption in target segments. This team handles multiple product areas including Dashboard and Reporting, Blogging, Social Planner, Email Marketing, Chat widget, Affiliate manager, Chat Widget, Template Library, Brand Boards etc.

HighLevel is an exciting place to work as it gives adrenaline to build and help our user base.

  • We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users
  • It’s never somebody else’s job - Take ownership as a company owner
  • We are passionately focussed on adding value for our users
  • We deliver fast using lean principles (Agile framework). We go to market in weeks instead of quarters
  • A good innovative idea always gets tested and we deliver based on feedbacks
  • We embrace that improvement is constant and iterative.
  • Constant Learning Growth graph - You will learn how to scale B2B SaaS Startup and build relevant, impactful products for customers
  • We are do-ers and go-getters to achieve team adoptions.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy and execution for our Template Library, Brand Board, and Countdown Timer initiatives.

You'll own the end-to-end product vision for how agency owners, subaccount users, marketers, and end customers create on-brand assets at scale, codify their business DNA, and drive urgency-based conversions inside HighLevel — turning fragmented design assets, brand identity, and conversion tooling into a unified, AI-powered creation ecosystem that spans every product surface.

This is a highly strategic, cross-cutting role with outsized impact on time-to-value, agency monetization, brand consistency, and conversion lift — transforming three foundational platform capabilities into category-defining products that can replace best-in-class point solutions (Canva-class design surfaces, Google Pomelli-style brand systems, Deadline Funnel, and Elfsight).

What You'll Own 1. Strategy & Vision

Own the north-star vision and roadmap for:

  • Template Library (multi-product, marketplace-ready, AI-enhanced creation engine)
  • Brand Board (centralized business DNA that flows into every HighLevel product)
  • Countdown Timer (multi-surface, dynamically synced, conversion-focused engagement primitive)

Translate company strategy into clear, measurable product outcomes (e.g., template adoption, agency template revenue, brand-board attach rate, cross-product asset reuse, timer-driven conversion lift, replacement of third-party tools like Deadline Funnel and Elfsight).

Map and deeply understand the ecosystem: agency owners, agency designers/marketers, subaccount users, end customers, template creators (monetizing agencies), and enterprise stakeholders standardizing brand at scale.

  • Product Specific Responsibilities
  • Template Library: Own the end-to-end vision for a multi-product template catalog spanning 12+ HighLevel surfaces, from niche-based discovery and agency template monetization to a Canva-class, AI-native creation engine — enabling users to generate, clone, and customize on-brand assets from a prompt or URL.
  • Brand Board: Build and maintain HighLevel's single source of truth for business identity — capturing logos, colors, typography, and voice — and ensure those values propagate automatically across every product surface, with a roadmap toward AI-powered brand extraction, smart drift detection, and generative brand asset creation.
  • Countdown Timer: Own a multi-surface conversion primitive that embeds across funnels, sites, and emails with dynamically synced urgency, expanding into a full conversion platform that replaces Deadline Funnel and Elfsight with evergreen timers, behavioral triggers, smart expiry actions, and measurable conversion analytics.
  • Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership Translate vision and PRDs (Template Library platform, Brand Board, Countdown Timer) into prioritized, outcome-driven roadmaps and shipped outcomes.

    • Run structured discovery: customer interviews (agency owners, agency designers, end customers), prototype testing, workflow audits, and competitive analysis (Canva, Figma, Webflow templates, Google Pomelli, Deadline Funnel, Elfsight, and emerging AI design tools).

    Collaborate closely with:

    • Engineering to plan, scope, and deliver platform-quality releases — especially given the cross-product integration surface area
    • Design to build intuitive, scalable UX for creation, brand setup, and timer configuration
    • AI/ML to ship generative templates, brand extraction, and clone-any-asset capabilities
    • Data/Analytics to instrument metrics, prove conversion lift, and measure marketplace and adoption health
    • Sales/CS/Support to shape enablement, packaging, monetization mechanics, and feedback loops
    • Partner/Marketplace teams for the agency template monetization motion (creator onboarding, payouts, governance)

    Drive alignment and narrative: clearly communicate tradeoffs, decisions, and progress to stakeholders and leadership.

    What You'll Bring
  • 8+ years in Product Management
  • Experience in one or more of:
    • Template, design, or creation products (Canva-class, Figma, Webflow, email/landing-page builders)
    • Brand systems, design systems, or DAM (digital asset management) products
    • Marketplace or creator-monetization platforms (template marketplaces, app stores, plugin ecosystems)
    • Conversion/marketing tools (timers, popups, personalization, A/B testing, urgency widgets)
    • Cross-product platform surfaces that integrate into many product areas
  • Strong design and creation product sensibility — you have opinions about editor UX, "make it mine" flows, and what makes a creation product feel magical
  • Strong analytical and technical fluency:
    • Comfortable partnering with Engineering/Data/AI on data flows, generative pipelines, and integration patterns
    • Can define robust metrics for adoption, monetization, and conversion lift
    • Can reason about APIs, embeds, multi-product integration, and scalable configuration frameworks
  • Proven track record of moving business metrics (adoption, retention, expansion, monetization, conversion)
  • Bonus: experience shipping AI-powered creation features, marketplace mechanics, or replacing established third-party tools with native capabilities
  • Demonstrated ability to lead without authority, influence cross-functional partners, and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, and GTM
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; can create crisp narratives for executives and individual contributors
How Success Will Be Measured (First 12 Months)

  • A clear, aligned 12–18 month roadmap for Template Library, Brand Board, and Countdown Timer is defined and in execution
  • Meaningful improvements in:
    • Template adoption and breadth (templates used per account, cross-product template usage, time-to-first-asset)
    • Agency template monetization (creators onboarded, templates listed, GMV from agency-created templates)
    • Brand Board attach and propagation (% of accounts with a completed Brand Board, % of assets created using Brand Board values, multi-product reuse)
    • Countdown Timer adoption and impact (timers deployed across funnels/sites/emails, measurable conversion lift, displacement of Deadline Funnel/Elfsight usage among customers)
    • AI feature adoption (usage of AI-generated templates, clone-any-asset, brand auto-extraction) — with a credible path to "AI-first" creation
  • Strong internal adoption and understanding of these capabilities by Sales, CS, and Support (enablement, demos, consistent positioning)
You are seen as the single-threaded owner and strategic leader for creation, brand, and conversion-engagement primitives across the platform

Equal Employment Opportunity Information

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. descriptionHtml:
About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About The Role

Glean is seeking a Product Manager to help solve a ubiquitous problem that all knowledge workers in the world struggle with on a daily basis. You’ll deliver best-in-class products for finding, curating, sharing, discovering, and managing knowledge. We’ve only taken the first step towards our long-term vision of an intelligent work assistant, and we need great product leaders to take us the rest of the way.

We’re currently a very lean product team, so you’ll have an outsized role in shaping both the product roadmap and the product team itself. You’ll collaborate closely with our stellar Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Success partners to understand our customers and build category-defining tools. You’ll wear many hats and gain both breadth and depth of experience. As Glean’s PM for Protect ( Security and Governance) you’ll develop new technologies and product features spanning explainable / transparent AI systems, identification and prevention of various vectors of AI risks, and the observability, security and privacy features around AI agents and underlying data for our customers.

You Will

  • Spending a lot of time with our customers to deeply understand their knowledge needs
  • Developing key parts of our product roadmap, marrying customers’ needs with our product vision
  • Empowering your team by giving context, setting direction, and building alignment
  • Driving customer-focused decisions, clear prioritization, and efficient execution
  • Coordinating cross-functionally with with leadership, go-to-market teams, and other key stakeholders across the company
  • Building processes that will scale as our team and company go through rapid growth

About You

  • You have 8+ years of experience in product management at SaaS companies, primarily serving large enterprises with responsibilities spanning security, governance, trust, identity, data integrations.
  • You have a strong technical background and experience with both UX and API driven products, integration paths, and 3rd party product partnerships.
  • You are an excellent written and verbal communicator.
  • You have a proven track record of taking ownership, taking initiative, and delivering results.
  • You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.
  • You have a learning and growth mindset.
  • You are mission-first and understand that your success is measured by your product and team’s success.

Location:

  • This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

Description

Responsibilities:

Marketplace Strategy & Partnership Development:

  • Map the AI data landscape: Develop a comprehensive view of what data types frontier model builders need most and where market gaps exist that we can uniquely fill.
  • Integrate our existing capabilities: Orchestrate synthetic data pipelines, expert-curated data from GenAI business line, generalist annotations from search/ads workflows, and physical-world data from automotive pipelines into a unified marketplace offering.
  • Unlock new data sources: Forge partnerships to access premium content behind paywalls and enterprise datasets that haven't been available to AI builders.
  • Onboard external data producers: Identify organisations generating valuable datasets that model builders need but lack the infrastructure to monetise on their own.
  • Structure win-win deals: Design partnership models and monetisation frameworks that work for data producers, AI companies, and our platform.
  • Build the technical integration: Define how diverse data sources connect to our marketplace infrastructure while maintaining quality standards and provenance tracking.
  • Execute the vision: Transform fragmented data capabilities into a coherent marketplace that establishes TELUS Digital AI as the central hub where AI builders source training data.

Product Strategy & Roadmap Definition:

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and phased roadmap for the AI Data Marketplace-including data discovery, licensing models, quality verification, and integration capabilities.
  • Prioritise features ruthlessly based on marketplace impact: enabling seamless data discovery, streamlining partnership onboarding, building trust through provenance tracking, and creating transparent monetisation mechanisms.
  • Develop clear, actionable product requirements, user stories, and specifications that effectively bridge operational needs with technical solutions.

Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Drive the product development lifecycle from ideation through requirements, design oversight, launch, and iteration.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Business Development, Legal, Finance, and existing product lines to ensure marketplace velocity and strategic alignment.
  • Champion a data-driven approach, using marketplace metrics (supply/demand balance, deal velocity, data quality signals) to continuously refine product strategy and partnership models

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience (8-10 years) in Product Management, with a clear track record of launching and iterating on complex systems, operational tools, or data platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to deeply understand complex operational workflows first-hand and translate those insights into impactful product requirements.
  • Prior experience in B2B, partnerships, or growth product management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; highly proficient in using data (quantitative and qualitative) to diagnose problems and guide decisions.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills – capable of building strong relationships and driving alignment across diverse teams (ops, technical, business).
  • Experience defining product vision, strategy, and roadmaps, particularly in ambiguous or rapidly evolving environments.

Preferred / Bonus:

  • Experience in domains directly related to data operations, data annotation platforms, data quality systems, AI/ML infrastructure, or managing specialised expert talent networks.
  • Past entrepreneurial experience, or as a software/ML engineer or designer
  • Experience working on multi-sided marketplaces
  • Experience with products designed for technical, scientific, or highly skilled knowledge workers.
  • You have multiple side projects/initiatives and the work to show for it

About Company:

TELUS Digital is the customer experience transformation partner to the world's most admired brands. Our diverse team weaves data, technology, and human ingenuity to deliver differentiated customer journeys, drive operational effectiveness, and scale AI solutions with meaningful value and positive impact.

We craft real-world solutions in the moments that matter, from customer acquisition to lifelong loyalty. Enabled by our global reach - spanning 78,000 experts in 33 countries - and deep industry expertise, we help over 600 organizations make the customer experience feel effortless.

Our solutions span Data & AI, Digital Experience & IT, CX Management and Trust & Safety. At the core of our innovation is Fuel iX™, an enterprise-grade generative AI platform that helps clients safely access and optimize leading LLMs to scale their own AI from pilot to production.

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicant's qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.


Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.




AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.


Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.




Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams – Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official ‘name@cvent.com’ email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud


In this Role, you will:


Strategic Product Leadership

  • Own your domain roadmap tied to measurable OKRs—define strategy, drive outcomes, and hold the line on scope discipline.
  • Run structured Problem & Solution Discovery before committing to build; validate with leadership, customers, and cross-functional partners.
  • Drive Go-To-Market readiness end-to-end: from inception through launch, adoption, and post-release success measurement.

AI-First Product Thinking

  • Embed AI as a default lens across every phase of product management—champion AI-native processes within your team.
  • Own end-to-end development of AI-powered features, including evals and measurable outcome tracking.
  • Leverage AI tooling to improve your PM workflow; model and share productivity gains with the broader team.
  • Participate in AI forums; work toward defining team-level AI processes and contributing sessions or case studies.
  • Ensure all AI features meet Cvent's responsible AI standards.

Execution Excellence & Platform Health

  • Drive delivery accountability: sprint hygiene, backlog depth health, SLI/SLO monitoring, and prod bug leakage.
  • Define strategy to reach OKRs, NPS, and key product metrics; socialize alignment to business goals with leadership.
  • Make data-driven prioritization decisions using Mixpanel, ProductBoard, Sigma, and similar platforms.
  • Write crisp, unambiguous product specs and user stories with full acceptance criteria before sprint start.

Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions in your domain; own escalation paths and surface deviations proactively.
  • Lead multi-stakeholder alignment across Sales, CS, Engineering, UX, and Leadership—with 360° feedback collected mid-year and annually.
  • Present roadmap progress and risks clearly to leadership; no stakeholder should be chasing you for an update.
  • Influence without authority—build alignment at all levels of the organization through trust, clarity, and data.

People Development & Team Capability

  • Mentor junior PMs through structured 1:1s, skill development plans, and goal alignment—hold the bar on accountability.
  • Build AI competency within your squad: assess baseline, design a learning path, and track adoption.
  • Identify and create stretch opportunities for high performers; drive adoption of Cvent processes and tools.
  • Contribute to improvements and a culture of continuous learning within the PM org.


Here's what you need:


  • 12–15 years of experience with 7+ years in product management for technology products.
  • Demonstrated experience building or shipping AI-powered products; hands-on proficiency with AI tools is required.
  • Proficiency with analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Gainsight PX, Pendo, or similar) to measure and drive adoption.
  • Strong product sense: can define strategy, articulate the "why," and translate ambiguity into clear roadmaps.
  • Solid grasp of software development, integrations, and system design—able to earn deep technical credibility.
  • Track record of mentoring PMs and elevating team capability, not just individual execution.
  • Exceptional communicator and influencer—comfortable driving alignment across C-suite, engineering, and customers.
  • Analytical, data-driven, and energized by complexity in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

Description

Role description

At TELUS Digital AI, we are looking for highly capable folks to join our product team. In this role,

you will play a pivotal role in shaping the vision, strategy, and execution of our products by

contributing to the entire product lifecycle.

From ideation to launch, you will drive impactful initiatives that address customer needs and

align with business goals. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will ensure the delivery

of high-quality products & solutions while staying informed about market trends and fostering

innovation. Depending on your level, you will lead product strategies, mentor team members, or

support execution and delivery under guidance.

Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business

objectives.

  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, marketing,

and sales teams to deliver exceptional products.

  • Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer interviews to identify

opportunities for growth and innovation.

  • Prioritize product initiatives, balancing customer needs, market trends, and resource

availability.

  • Track product performance using key metrics like adoption and NPS, iterating based on

insights and feedback.

  • Write clear product requirements and user stories, ensuring alignment with development

teams.

  • Mentor and guide team members, fostering their development and ensuring alignment

across stakeholders.

  • Manage trade-offs between short-term and long-term objectives, optimizing for timely

delivery and technical excellence.

This role demands a strong strategic thinking, problem solving and execution capabilities to

navigate the fast moving landscape of AI. Your mission is critical and it’s a chance to contribute

to a technological narrative unfolding right in front of us.

Requirements

  • Product management related roles or founder-level experience in building highly

technical or developer-facing SaaS products.

  • Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • You have an eye for great products and can influence business decisions with qualitative

and quantitative reasoning.

About Company:

TELUS Digital is the customer experience transformation partner to the world's most admired brands. Our diverse team weaves data, technology, and human ingenuity to deliver differentiated customer journeys, drive operational effectiveness, and scale AI solutions with meaningful value and positive impact.

We craft real-world solutions in the moments that matter, from customer acquisition to lifelong loyalty. Enabled by our global reach - spanning 78,000 experts in 33 countries - and deep industry expertise, we help over 600 organizations make the customer experience feel effortless.

Our solutions span Data & AI, Digital Experience & IT, CX Management and Trust & Safety. At the core of our innovation is Fuel iX™, an enterprise-grade generative AI platform that helps clients safely access and optimize leading LLMs to scale their own AI from pilot to production.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicant's qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.
