Job title: AI Product Expert

  • Location: Hyderabad

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.

Job Summary

We are looking for an AI Product Expert to drive AI innovation, strategic communication, and effective change management within the organization. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of AI technologies, storytelling, and how to leverage AI products to solve business challenges. This role will be pivotal in shaping our AI strategy, guiding teams on the best use of AI tools, managing vendor relationships, and leading innovation projects. You will be instrumental in driving AI adoption across the organization, ensuring smooth integration of embedded AI solutions, and running rapid prototyping on POCs.

Job Highlights & Main Responsibilities

  • Strategic Role: Shape the AI strategy and provide the organization with insights on when and how to integrate AI products.
  • Innovation Focus: Lead innovation projects and be the bridge between AI development and organizational needs.
  • AI Expertise: Stay ahead of AI trends and market developments, applying an “outside-in” perspective to ensure we are leveraging the most relevant tools.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the organization to create synergy in AI product usage.
  • Vendor Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with AI product vendors and partners.

Main Responsibilities

  • AI Product Strategy & Storytelling:
    • Develop and communicate a clear AI strategy, aligning with business goals and driving AI adoption across departments.
    • Craft compelling narratives around AI technologies, showcasing their impact and potential value to various stakeholders.
    • Lead the development of AI storytelling frameworks to simplify complex AI concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • Change Management & Embedded AI:
    • Champion change management initiatives for AI adoption, ensuring smooth integration of AI solutions in the organization.
    • Partner with key departments to identify areas where AI can bring immediate value and lead the implementation of embedded AI products.
  • Innovation Projects & Rapid Prototyping:
    • Lead and manage AI innovation projects from ideation to execution.
    • Drive rapid prototyping of POCs to test new AI concepts, quickly validating and iterating on ideas.
    • Foster a culture of experimentation, quickly adopting new AI technologies to address business needs.
  • Vendor Management & External Relations:
    • Build and maintain relationships with external AI vendors and partners, ensuring access to the latest tools and technologies.
    • Collaborate with vendors to evaluate and implement AI products that align with business requirements.
    • Negotiate contracts, manage vendor deliverables, and ensure smooth integration of third-party AI products into existing systems.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Act as the AI ambassador within the organization, providing guidance on when to use what AI products and how to maximize their value.
    • Work closely with product, marketing, data, and engineering teams to create a cohesive AI roadmap and ensure alignment on objectives.
    • Coordinate across departments to ensure the successful deployment and scaling of AI-driven initiatives.
  • Market & Competitive Intelligence:
    • Continuously track and evaluate emerging AI technologies, industry trends, and competitor activities.
    • Provide thought leadership and expert analysis on where AI can add value across various domains.
    • Vendor Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with AI product vendors and partners.

    Qualifications

    About You:
  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience:
    • 10+ years of experience in AI product management, AI strategy, or innovation management.
    • Proven track record in leading AI adoption and change management initiatives in large organizations.
    • Experience designing and deploying LLM-powered and agentic AI solutions (RAG, autonomous agents) using OpenAI API, Claude, and frameworks like LangChain. Strong understanding of MCP-based integrations, embeddings, and scalable AI systems.
    • Hands-on experience with AI technologies (machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, etc.) and product lifecycle management.
    • Strong experience in vendor management and external partnerships.
    • Experience in rapid prototyping, running POCs, and innovation project management.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts for non-technical audiences.
    • Strong leadership and influencing abilities to drive cross-functional collaboration and change.
    • Knowledge of AI product ecosystems, including both open-source and commercial tools.
    • Experience with AI storytelling and creating persuasive business cases for AI adoption.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment with a focus on delivering results.

  • Additional Skills:
    • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
    • Strategic thinking with a results-oriented mindset.
    • Passion for AI and technology innovation.
    • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management frameworks is a plus.
Preferred

  • Experience in industries like tech, finance, healthcare, or manufacturing where AI is being actively deployed at scale.
  • Background in AI-driven product development or customer experience improvement.
  • Certifications in AI, Machine Learning, or related areas are a plus.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to lead a critical function at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You will have a direct impact on our business performance in a high-growth region and work with a talented, passionate team to build the future of data and AI in the FMCH industry.

Why us?

At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.

We Are Challengers.

We Are Dedicated To Making Self-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things

All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.

Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.

Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.

Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.

Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

descriptionHtml:
We're building a new product team in India to help shape how customers build, deploy, and operate AI applications on MongoDB. This is an early hire on a growing team—you'll join while the team is still taking shape, with the opportunity to have real impact from the start.

You'll report to a Director of Product Management based in Europe, working async-first with partners across India, EMEA, and North America. The engineering team in India is being built in parallel, so you'll be working closely with engineers from the early days of the team.

We are looking to speak to candidates based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

What you'll own

You'll be the end-to-end owner for a core area of our AI application platform—from discovery and vision through roadmap, delivery, and iteration. This is a senior individual contributor role where you lead through ownership, expertise, and cross-functional influence.

Day to day, that means:

  • Defining product strategy and roadmap for your area, aligned with MongoDB's broader AI strategy and business goals
  • Talking to customers — from AI-native startups to large enterprises — to understand how they build and deploy AI applications, where they struggle, and what MongoDB should do about it
  • Writing clear product narratives, memos, and specs that align stakeholders, clarify trade-offs, to guide conversations with engineering, design, product marketing, etc
  • Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders—including Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Partners, Sales, and Developer Relations—to scope, prioritize, and ship, balancing experimentation with reliability and scale, and driving positioning, launches, and enablement
  • Identifying new opportunities autonomously—spotting gaps, shaping problem spaces, researching industry trends and running discovery sessions with customers
  • Define and own clear success metrics for your area and use them to prioritize, make trade-offs and communicate impact

You'll develop deep expertise in how companies build AI applications — including agentic workflows, retrieval and memory, evaluation, observability, and deployment patterns.

How we work

  • Async-first. Documentation and written communication are how decisions travel across time zones
  • Sync when it makes sense. When we need to discuss something live, we hop on a call to unbundle issues together
  • In-person when it matters. The team gets together periodically for planning, relationship-building, and the kind of work that's better done face to face

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in product management (or equivalent) building platforms, infrastructure, or developer-facing products — ideally in cloud, data, or AI
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of a product area: from framing the problem and vision through roadmap, execution, launch, and iteration
  • Customer obsession: you're comfortable running discovery calls, digging into workflows, and turning messy feedback into clear product decisions
  • Strong written and live communication: clear docs, productive meetings, confident stakeholder presentations. This matters more in an async, distributed team — writing is how you lead
  • Technical depth sufficient to collaborate with senior engineers on distributed systems, cloud services, and AI/ML tooling, and to ask good questions when something is unclear
  • Curiosity about AI: you follow how companies are building AI applications — agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG, fine-tuning, or other emerging patterns
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you help define the problem, the success metrics, and the path forward. In an early-stage team, this is the job

Bonus points

  • Experience building developer tools, AI platforms, or MLOps/LLMOps products.
  • Engineering background or deep experience partnering with engineering on technical products.
  • Experience with enterprise customers on mission-critical workloads.
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Figma Make) to move faster and amplify impact.

How we'll measure success (30/60/90 days)

We need someone who can onboard quickly and start driving impact early.

In your first 30 days, you will:

  • Ramp up on MongoDB products, AI application patterns, and how our teams work
  • Shadow customer calls and internal forums to learn current strategy, open questions, and key stakeholders
  • Produce a clear written overview of your product area: current state, key bets, and known gaps

By 60 days, you will:

  • Take ownership of a set of customer relationships and run your own discovery conversations each week
  • Own and socialize an initial strategy and roadmap proposal for your area, with clear problem statements and success metrics
  • Partner with engineering and design to shape and drive at least one scoped initiative into execution

By 90 days, you will:

  • Be the go-to owner for your product area, driving prioritization and day-to-day decision-making across functions
  • Lead customer- and data-informed iterations on what you’ve shipped, adjusting the roadmap based on what you’re learning
  • Contribute to the broader AI application platform strategy with perspectives from your domain, customers, and the field

Why this role

MongoDB is one of the most widely adopted database platforms in the world, used by tens of thousands of customers — including much of the Fortune 100 and a fast-growing set of AI-native startups. Our cloud platform, Atlas, runs across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

This role puts you at the center of how MongoDB powers AI applications at scale. You’ll own a critical slice of that story, from strategy through delivery and adoption.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

descriptionHtml:
Your Impact

The Senior Product Manager for AI Platform at DISCO is responsible for driving the product strategy and execution for our centralized AI infrastructure. They lead a high-velocity functional team and collaborate with US-based experience groups to deliver innovative, reusable services that power legal outcomes across our product suite. By bridging the gap between technical research and production reality, they use customer needs and business goals to shape the roadmap for DISCO's AI foundation. They will own their platform’s outcomes, provide strategic clarity to global stakeholders, and ensure our technology is scalable, defensible, and cost-effective.

What You'll Do

  • Drive AI Platform Strategy: Lead the investment plan that best enables teams to leverage AI capabilities across all DISCO products while partnering with engineering on the technical approach and priority order.
  • Lead for Delivery: Partner with your team of engineers in the Gurugram office to translate technical research into production-ready services with high velocity.
  • Shape the Infrastructure Roadmap: Collaborate with leaders in engineering and product journeys to prioritize and deliver plug-and-play services that unblock feature teams.
  • Deliver Strategic Outcomes: Partner across DISCO to ensure wide-scale adoption of platform services, measuring success by the increased efficiency and cost-effectiveness of our legal technology solutions.

Who You Are

  • Experience: 5-8+ years of Product Management experience, with a proven track record of scaling internal platforms to serve multiple business units at enterprise scale while managing backend services, developer platforms, or complex AI-powered features.
  • B2B Platform Strategist: You provide strategic clarity by translating complex stakeholder needs into a definitive roadmap and ensure every platform investment is tied to trackable outcomes.
  • Outcome-Oriented Leader: You break complex problems into achievable milestones and relentlessly prioritize speed-to-market and ROI over technical perfection.
  • Global Operator: You thrive on autonomy, mastering async communication to run complex projects and lead teams across 10+ hour timezone (CST to IST) gaps.
  • Technical Partner: You can navigate architectural discussions regarding RAG, model lifecycles, and vector databases while remaining focused on user impact.

Even Better If You Have...

  • A portfolio of high-scale AI products delivered to enterprise users.
  • Legal tech experience or a deep understanding of the legal domain.

Core DISCO Product Competencies

  • Customer Focus & Insight: Deeply understand user needs and pain points through research to guide product decisions.
  • Strategic Clarity: Create and communicate clear direction aligned with business goals and measurable outcomes.
  • Delivery of Top Priorities: Drive high-quality and timely delivery of the most important new products and experiences.
  • Own the Outcome: Take full responsibility for achieving results and measurable impact from definition through iteration.

Perks of DISCO

  • Open, inclusive, and fun environment
  • Benefits, including medical and dental insurance
  • Competitive salary plus discretionary bonus
  • Opportunity to be a part of a startup that is revolutionizing the legal industry
  • Growth opportunities throughout the company

About DISCO

DISCO provides a cloud-native, artificial intelligence-powered legal solution that simplifies ediscovery, legal document review and case management for enterprises, law firms, legal services providers and governments. Our scalable, integrated solution enables legal departments to easily collect, process and review enterprise data that is relevant or potentially relevant to legal matters.

At DISCO, we believe AI is a core enabler of how work gets done. All employees are expected to proactively adopt and responsibly use AI tools to drive efficiency, improve outcomes, and continuously evolve how they operate in their role.

Are you ready to help us fulfill our mission to use technology to strengthen the rule of law? Join us!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Job Description

Zendesk is a global leader in AI-first customer service and employee service software, renowned for its powerful yet customer-friendly solutions. At Zendesk, we believe in building better customer relationships through our suite of products that are smart, flexible, and reliable.

We have a rare opportunity for a seasoned product manager to drive the evolution of our product experiences at Zendesk. This PM will define, execute, and iterate on building AI-augmented products that empower our billions of end-users, millions of agents, and thousands of admins to be able to give and receive world class service on Zendesk.

What You'll Do

Zendesk is looking for an innovative and passionate product manager to drive product development product experiences at Zendesk. This leader will be critical in defining the strategy, vision, and roadmap around our notifications platform for (human) agents & admins, in addition to defining products that ensure human agents are accountable to adhere/meet their KPIs around their customer service performance.

You will be responsible for working with our 130k+ customers to understand the bottlenecks and pain points they (and their customers) run into when it comes to providing customer service, and designing/launching scalable solutions to empower them. You’ll work cross-functionally with partners across product and engineering, design, go-to-market, data science, and program management to plan and execute on our product development goals.

This role requires deep technical expertise in SaaS Product Development, AI/ML products, and customer-centric delivery. The ideal candidate has led initiatives in the past that have significantly impacted adoption and productivity metrics across tens of thousands of customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver specialized and inspiring product leadership to stakeholders, customers, and counterparts around moving our product experiences forward
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product design, marketing, customer success, sales, data science, program management, documentation, and legal teams to enhance existing product experiences, and build 0-1 functionality in this space
  • Develop and articulate compelling roadmaps and strategies for your domain, informed by customer needs, key personas, market trends, and business objectives.
  • Engage directly with key our broad set of external customers to gather requirements and feedback for your product area
  • Own and drive key performance indicators (KPIs) related to product delivery, customer satisfaction, and business impact
  • Cultivate a culture of product excellence, fostering innovation and customer-centricity within the Product Management org at Zendesk
  • Share your subject matter expertise, and build knowledge / empathy across the business for your product domain

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with a track record of launching AI products in the B2B SaaS space
  • Strong technical acumen with the ability to interface effectively with customers, engineering teams and design teams.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with demonstrated experience in leading specialized, cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex solutions clearly.
  • Ability to think strategically about the challenges specific to evolving a customer service platform in a world where AI/automation is prolific
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on key metrics and user behavior.

This role is a rare opportunity to drive major customer and business outcomes in a high-growth environment. If you're passionate about building great products, we'd love to hear from you.

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

descriptionHtml:
About Learneo
Learneo is a platform of builder-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.

Role Overview
Now we’re building a full AI-powered creation platform that supports them from the first spark of an idea to a finished, shareable piece of work.

The creation suite is a key pillar of this evolution, the space where users can transform their words into visually compelling assets: presentations, campaigns, PDFs, social posts, and more.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead this effort and shape the future of how people create with Quillbot.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the evolution of the creation suite from MVP to a flagship Quillbot product—driving the roadmap, success metrics, and user experience.
  • Own the end-to-end user journey for visual creation—from ideation to layout to export.
  • Partner with engineers, designers, marketing, brand, SEO and researchers to turn text and ideas into adaptive, multimodal outputs.
  • Define and validate workflows, templates, and design systems that make non-designers feel like creators.
  • Collaborate closely with the Writing and Chat product teams to ensure seamless handoffs between idea, draft, and design.
  • Use data, research, and product intuition to balance user delight, technical feasibility, and business impact.
  • Lead a cross-functional pod toward measurable outcomes—traffic, engagement, retention, and satisfaction.

Qualification 

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building/growing creation or design-centric products.
  • A track record of taking consumer-facing tools from 0→1 or 1→N, ideally with products in the creative or productivity space.
  • Experience in AI-assisted or automation-heavy workflows—text-to-image, auto-layout, or generative creation—is highly desirable.
  • Deep understanding of UX for creative tools and empathy for non-technical users.
  • Strong design sensibility—you understand layout, visual hierarchy, and what makes creation feel effortless.
  • Data-driven mindset; comfort working with analytics to inform decisions and measure success.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across design, engineering, marketing, and leadership.

What You Can Expect to Do in Your 180 Days

First 30 Days: Learn & Align

  • Deep-dive into Quillbot’s creation platform vision, user personas, and current MVP.
  • Understand the existing creation suite experience, performance metrics, and user pain points.
  • Conduct a competitive benchmarking.
  • Build strong partnerships with Design, Engineering, and AI/UX Research leads.
  • Align on near-term success metrics and team priorities.

30-90 Days: Define & Prioritize

  • Craft a clear roadmap for post-MVP development—defining which workflows, templates, and features matter most.
  • Lead early experiments in user experience, template expansion, and AI-assisted creation.
  • Establish analytics and feedback loops for measuring product success.
  • Partner with marketing and growth to position the creation suite within Quillbot’s ecosystem.

90–180 Days—Execute & Scale

  • Launch new workflows or features that significantly improve user creation speed and output quality.
  • Define and validate the long-term strategy for multimodal, brand-aware creation.
  • Drive engagement growth and user retention through data-backed iteration.
  • Build the foundation for Quillbot’s primary visual creation surface.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own one of the most impactful growth and experimentation surfaces at Quillbot.
  • Shape how millions of users discover and first experience Quillbot.
  • Work at the intersection of AI, growth, and product systems.
  • Collaborate with a team that values speed, learning, and thoughtful product decisions.
  • Be a key driver of Quillbot’s transition from individual tools to a cohesive creation platform.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Medical coverage
  • Life and accidental insurance
  • Vacation & leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
  • Developmental opportunities through education & developmental reimbursements & professional workshops
  • Maternity & parental leave
  • Hybrid & remote model with flexible working hours
  • On-site & remote company events throughout the year
  • Tech & WFH stipends & new hire allowances
  • Employee referral program
  • Premium access to Quillbot

*Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. We strongly encourage you to apply if you're interested: we'd love to learn how you can amplify our team with your unique experience!

We are a virtual-first company with employees across the United States, Canada, India, Germany, and the Netherlands. Our compensation approach is market-based and varies by location while ensuring fairness, consistency, and transparency.

The base pay for this role is determined by several factors, including:

  • Relevant professional experience
  • Skills and expertise
  • Scope and responsibilities of the role
  • Internal equity considerations 

In addition to base salary, total compensation may include bonus, equity, and benefits. Eligibility depends on role, level, and location.

We are committed to equal pay for equal work, and all compensation decisions are made using consistent, gender-neutral criteria in alignment with pay transparency requirements

descriptionHtml:
About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Digital Product Manager.

In This Role, You Will

  • Act as an advisor to senior leadership to develop or influence digital products, initiatives, plans, specifications, resources, and long-term goals for highly complex business and technical needs across a functional area within the Digital environment
  • Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise
  • Deliver solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
  • Coordinate highly complex activities and guidance to others
  • Provide vision, direction and expertise to senior leadership on implementing innovative and significant digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have significant impact
  • Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise
  • Serve as an expert advisor to leadership

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

  • Strong understanding of identity and access management concepts, including authentication, authorization, access governance (RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC), identity lifecycle management, and privileged access management.
  • Proven experience in leading and scaling large product organizations, managing senior product managers and product leaders.
  • Strong ability to define and drive product strategy and roadmap execution across complex, enterprise-grade IAM environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in operating at both strategic and execution levels, balancing long-term vision with delivery outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience working with and leading Agile teams using frameworks such as Scrum and Kanban, with a focus on delivering measurable business and security outcomes.
  • Familiarity with agile collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise IAM ecosystems, including identity governance, PAM, and cloud IAM platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage senior and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to identify, assess, and proactively manage risks, interdependencies, and cross-functional impacts in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while driving clarity, alignment, and execution at scale.
  • Experience in building product operating models, governance frameworks, and driving product excellence across teams.
  • Job Location - Bangalore / Hyderabad.

Job Expectations:

  • This is a Senior leadership role responsible for defining and delivering enterprise IAM capabilities across all IAM products areas. This role will drive IAM product outcomes, aligning security, compliance, and user experience with business priorities in close partnership with product management, engineering, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Lead and scale the IAM Product organization in India, managing a team of 10+ product managers and senior product leaders, while building a strong leadership pipeline.
  • Own and drive the IAM product portfolio strategy, aligning multiple product areas with enterprise security and business objectives.
  • Develop, evolve, and communicate the IAM product vision, roadmap, and priorities, ensuring alignment with regulatory, security, and business needs.
  • Drive innovation and modernization across IAM domains including authentication, access governance, identity lifecycle management, privileged access, and emerging areas such as dynamic access (ABAC/ReBAC), JIT access, and AI/agent identity governance.
  • Strengthen governance models, including RBAC/ABAC frameworks, audit readiness, and compliance controls across products.
  • Define and track measurable outcomes including improvements in identity risk posture, access governance maturity, adoption, and user experience.
  • Own and prioritize the product portfolio and backlog (epics → features → user stories), ensuring clear alignment with strategic goals.
  • Lead Agile delivery execution with strong dependency, release, and risk management across multiple teams and products.
  • Establish and enforce scalable product governance, operating models, and best practices across the organization.
  • Act as the business and product authority for IAM, influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving enterprise-wide alignment.
  • Partner closely with engineering, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality solutions.
  • Represent the IAM Product organization in executive forums and drive alignment with global leadership and regional teams.
  • Facilitate continuous collaboration across customers, stakeholders, and delivery teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Proactively mitigate identity-driven risks in partnership with cybersecurity teams and ensure alignment with enterprise policies and regulatory requirements.

Posting End Date:

29 Jun 2026

  • Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit's risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

Applicants With Disabilities

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo .

Drug and Alcohol Policy

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

Wells Fargo Recruitment And Hiring Requirements

  • Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.
  • Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

Reference Number

R-546257

We are hiring for Senior Consultant/ Principal - Business Consulting roles in the Financial Services practice.


Where are we hiring?


Primary locations: Hyderabad

Note - Location of posting is subject to business requirements.


We are hiring for Senior Consultant/ Principal - Business Consulting roles in the Financial Services practice.


Who are we?


  • Infosys (NYSE: INFY) is a global leader in consulting, technology and outsourcing solutions with annual revenues of $19.3 B as of March 2025. We enable clients, in more than 56 countries, to stay a step ahead of emerging business trends and outperform the competition.
  • Infosys Consulting partners with clients to transform their businesses in areas such as strategy, processes, organization, systems, and risk. Infosys Consulting has offices across the US, Europe, APAC, and India.
  • We are Value Integrators – we deliver realized business value by managing transformations from strategy through execution, including operating and optimizing delivered solutions.
  • The Consulting team in India works with its overseas counterparts to provide business consulting services to clients in the US, Europe, Asia Pacific and Middle East markets.
  • At Infosys Consulting, we recognize the need for greater Diversity and Inclusion at the workplace, and on this journey, we place special emphasis on enabling gender diversity. Women form an integral part of our company and we do all that we can to build an inclusive, supportive, and safe workplace.


What are we looking for?


We are seeking a smart, self-driven, high energy and experienced Product Owner to join our dynamic team. As a Product Owner you will be expected to work with products and responsible for defining, prioritizing, and communicating the product vision to the development team and other stakeholders. You will play a crucial role in driving the success of these products by ensuring they deliver exceptional value to their customers and align with the business objectives within the complex and regulated financial services landscape.


We are looking for candidates with a deep understanding of Financial Services with experience in the below mentioned areas:

  • Product Owner, Product Strategy, Product Management, Product Roadmap, Feature Prioritization
  • Understanding of enterprise capabilities in Financial Services i.e. Identity verification, API & Integration Layer, Digital banking Infrastructure, Payment platforms (Zelle), Card Management
  • Consulting & advisory experience with top-tier consulting organizations strongly preferred.
  • Full time MBA from top-tier business schools
  • 7+ years working in agile delivery with 5+ years of relevant experience working as a lead Product Owner within the Financial Services domain.
  • Ability to lead the product functional design process and create the product roadmap based on an intimate knowledge of the operational processes and technology.
  • Track and report product performance post-launch to evaluate / request future investment.
  • Expertise with agile delivery suite including Jira, Asana, Trello and Azure Boards
  • Experience with agile testing and technical engineering techniques (TDD, BDD,) tools is a plus.
  • Advanced Product Owner certifications


Overall Experience Required: 7 - 14 years.


What will you do?


At Infosys Consulting, your responsibilities include but are not limited to:


  • Product Vision and Strategy:
  • Develop and maintain a clear and compelling product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with the overall business goals and market opportunities within the financial services sector.
  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer feedback analysis to identify needs and opportunities.
  • Translate the product vision into actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team.


  • Product Backlog Management:
  • Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring it is transparent, visible, and reflects the most valuable work to be delivered.
  • Continuously refine and groom the backlog, working closely with stakeholders and the development team to ensure clarity and understanding.
  • Make difficult prioritization decisions based on business value, technical feasibility, and regulatory requirements.


  • Stakeholder Management:
  • Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, including business leaders, compliance teams, operations, marketing, and customer support.
  • Effectively communicate the product vision, roadmap, and progress to stakeholders, managing expectations and gathering feedback.
  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.


  • Sprint Planning and Execution:
  • Participate actively in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews.
  • Provide clear guidance and clarification to the development team on user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Ensure the development team understands the "why" behind the work and the value it delivers.
  • Monitor and evaluate the progress of each sprint, ensuring deliverables align with the product roadmap and quality standards.


  • Product Delivery and Iteration:
  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success and identify areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate with the development team on testing and quality assurance efforts.
  • Facilitate product releases and ensure smooth rollouts.
  • Continuously iterate on the product based on data, feedback, and market trends.


  • Compliance and Regulatory Awareness:
  • Maintain a strong understanding of relevant financial services regulations and compliance requirements (e.g., KYC, AML, GDPR, PSD2).
  • Ensure that product development aligns with all applicable regulations and internal policies.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to address any regulatory concerns.

Job Category: Engineering & Cloud

Location: India - Telangana - Hyderabad

Copied!

Meet Our Team:

As a Senior Product Manager at Pega, you will own and drive critical cloud platform and developer experience capabilities that power a large-scale, enterprise SaaS platform. You will work at the intersection of Cloud, Platform, Product and Operations, and developer tooling, translating complex technical challenges into clear product outcomes that improve platform resilience, scalability, and deployment predictability.

This role is a high-impact individual contributor position, central to delivering reliable, automated, and enterprise-grade cloud platform services used by internal engineering teams and global enterprise customers.

Picture Yourself At Pega:

You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, and operations teams to ensure platform capabilities are not just built, but are intuitive, reliable, and scalable—supporting frictionless experiences across build, deploy, and operate lifecycles.

At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.

We expect you to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

What You'll Do At Pega:

  • Set product strategy using data-driven decisions by defining a clear cloud platform vision and roadmap, grounding priorities and trade-offs in platform metrics, customer feedback, and business outcomes.
  • Design for scale and long-term resilience by balancing near-term delivery with multi-tenant scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery needs across a large enterprise SaaS platform.
  • Drive platform reliability through measurable outcomes, owning availability, recovery, and operational readiness KPIs and partnering with engineering and operations to deliver automated, testable, and scalable solutions.
  • Enable safe change at scale by leading deployment orchestration, governance, and automation strategies that reduce risk, eliminate manual toil, and support predictable releases across environments.
  • Champion intuitive developer and operator experiences by improving end-to-end workflows and ensuring platform capabilities surface as clear, actionable, and productivity-enhancing experiences.
  • Execute through Agile and strong cross-functional collaboration, acting as Product Owner, prioritizing the backlog, and communicating product decisions, progress, and trade-offs clearly to engineering teams and senior stakeholders.

Who You Are:

  • You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
  • You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You've Accomplished:

  • 12+ years of experience in Technical Development and Architectural roles across Cloud solutions and 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, Platform Product Management, or similar roles.
  • Experience building or owning cloud, platform, or developer-facing products
  • Strong understanding of Agile product development and Product Owner responsibilities
  • Proven ability to work with distributed, cross-functional engineering teams and influence at scale
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, outcome-focused manner

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or equivalents)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment orchestration, reliability engineering, or cloud operations
  • Familiarity with infrastructure, control plane, or shared platform services
  • Strong data-driven mindset with a focus on measurable impact

Pega Offers You:

  • Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities
  • An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
  • Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company

This role is a high-impact individual contributor position, central to delivering reliable, automated, and enterprise-grade cloud platform services used by internal engineering teams and global enterprise customers.

Picture Yourself At Pega:

You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, and operations teams to ensure platform capabilities are not just built, but are intuitive, reliable, and scalable—supporting frictionless experiences across build, deploy, and operate lifecycles.

At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.

We expect you to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

What You'll Do At Pega:

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Lead Product Manager- Technical

Overview

  • Responsible for developing inspiring platform/product visions, derived from business needs, market opportunities, and technology trends
  • Using the Working Backwards method, decomposes business requirements and customer experiences into features and functions that drive the platform/product roadmap
  • Works with Technical Program Managers, Developers, UX designers, and internal customers to define the details behind the business requirements
  • Collects and shares user stories with engineering teams
  • Acts as the voice of the business customer and accountable for the platform services


  • Owns the working backwards document and vision for feature releases
  • Identifies gaps and charters new platform capabilities as required
  • Makes use of research, user studies, metrics and competitive analysis to understand the platform and business needs for a platform product
  • Compares features for competitive review to inform prioritization within a platform product release
  • Identifies innovations or performs test and learn experiments to create features that add more business and customer value for a platform product
  • Participates with the business in customer research to inform platform product feature needs
  • Contributes near-term input (quarterly) for the platform product portfolio and roadmap
  • Makes trade-off decisions on platform product features
  • Uses runtime metrics of their services in market as a feedback loop in to the backlog and balances the priorities against new feature requests
  • Exhibits expertise within platform feature area and coordinates with interdependent teams
  • Digests business customer requirements (user stories, use cases) and platform requirements for a platform feature set
  • Has visibility into the design of the user experience
  • Determines release goals for the platform and prioritizes assigned features according to business and platform value, adjusting throughout implementation as needed
  • Continuously monitors feature development at the feature level
  • Reviews product demo with the development team against acceptance criteria for the feature set
  • Prepares launches and monitors platform performances, adoption, and operational health for feature sets
  • Stays aligned with GTM plans for the feature set
  • Identifies issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirements and communicates to leadership
  • Supports and participates in post-launch reviews and ensures feedback is reincorporated into the feature
  • Works with internal teams and customer service to identify, classify, and prioritize feature-level customer issues
  • Develops and implements new metrics into measurement techniques; works with development teams to develop reports to monitor them
  • Independently identifies and researches anomalous performance; escalates findings to senior management
  • Coordinates internal forums to collect and identify feature-level development opportunities
  • Owns and manages product documentation; enables self-service support and/or works to reduce overhead
  • Identifies feature risks from business and customer feedback and in-depth analysis of operational performance; shares with senior leadership
  • Establishes a network within the organization; begins to build internal and external networks
  • Mentoring team members
  • Assists with candidate selection and onboarding


Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

descriptionHtml:
About CTeBS

CTeBS (Classic Technologies & Business Solutions) is a technology company building an integrated ecosystem of software products for the fashion manufacturing industry. As a subsidiary of Classic Fashion, one of the leading garment manufacturers, CTeBS builds software products that are first developed, implemented, and matured within Classic Fashion's own manufacturing operations, and subsequently offered to external customers across the industry. This unique model means our products are battle-tested in real production environments before they reach the market, giving us deep domain credibility and a genuine understanding of manufacturing floor challenges.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead and grow the Product Management function at CTeBS. This is a player-coach role — you will directly own one or more software products while also providing leadership, mentorship, and strategic direction to the existing PM team of 3. The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise with hands-on knowledge of manufacturing operations — ideally in apparel, garments, textiles, or closely adjacent industries (footwear, home textiles). You should be someone who understands shop floor realities, production planning, quality workflows, and the pain points of factory operations, and can translate that knowledge into compelling software products.


Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Strategy

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for one or more CTeBS software products — from discovery and ideation through development, launch, and iteration.
  • Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with both Classic Fashion's internal needs and external market opportunities.
  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery to identify product-market fit for external commercialisation.
  • Drive the transition of internally-matured products into market-ready offerings for external garment manufacturing customers.
  • Establish and track product KPIs, OKRs, and success metrics to measure product health and business impact.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 3 product professionals with varying experience levels.
  • Establish product management best practices, frameworks, and processes across the team.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, product reviews, and sprint retrospectives to ensure quality and accountability.
  • Build a culture of data-driven decision making, customer empathy, and continuous learning within the PM function.

Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary interface between the product team and Classic Fashion's manufacturing operations leadership.
  • Navigate the dual-stakeholder dynamic — balancing Classic Fashion's internal requirements with what makes products viable and scalable for external customers.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, QA, and delivery teams to ensure timely and quality product releases.
  • Present product strategy, progress, and outcomes to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

Domain Application

  • Leverage garment manufacturing domain expertise to identify high-impact product opportunities in areas such as production planning, line balancing, quality inspection, cut-make-trim operations, fabric management, and compliance tracking.
  • Translate complex manufacturing workflows into intuitive software experiences.
  • Stay current with industry trends in fashion manufacturing technology, Industry 4.0, and smart factory solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of overall professional experience with 6–7+ years specifically in product management roles.
  • Proven experience in manufacturing software — ERP, MES, PLM, factory operations platforms, or production management systems.
  • Domain knowledge in garment/apparel manufacturing, textiles, footwear, or closely adjacent industries.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or mentoring other product managers (not just managing products).
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working with cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Excellent analytical skills with experience using data to drive product decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present to senior stakeholders with confidence.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS product commercialisation — taking an internal tool or early product to external paying customers.
  • Familiarity with smart factory / Industry 4.0 concepts: IoT on the shop floor, real-time production monitoring, digital twins.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA or equivalent is a plus.

What We Offer

Opportunity to build and lead the Product Management function at a growing smart factory software company. Direct impact — your products will be used on real manufacturing floors serving global fashion brands. A unique product development model where every product is validated in real operations before market release. Collaborative work environment in Kochi with exposure to Classic Fashion's global manufacturing operations.

descriptionHtml:
Product Manager — Post-Order Experience

Department: Product Location: Mumbai, Onsite Experience: 3–4+ years

About The Role

Purplle is hiring a Product Manager to own the post-order experience — everything a customer

goes through after placing an order: order tracking, cancellations, returns and refunds, and customer

support. This is the part of the journey that decides whether a customer trusts us enough to come

back.

You'll own these flows end-to-end, treat them as products to be improved rather than systems to be

maintained, and be accountable for the metrics that show they're working — reachability of support,

resolution quality, and a smooth experience even when things go wrong.

What You'll Do

  • Own the post-order journey end-to-end — order tracking, cancellations, returns and refunds,

and order care — and set the roadmap, balancing quick wins (e.g., real-time tracking updates)

with longer-term bets (e.g., predictive self-service).

  • Make customer support reachable and effective: improve discoverability of help across key

journeys, strengthen self-service and automation, and ensure clean escalation to a human

agent when needed.

  • Reduce avoidable contacts (WISMO, status checks) by fixing root-cause friction in tracking and

communication — without making support harder to reach.

  • Raise resolution quality, measured by repeat contacts, reopens, and post-resolution satisfaction

— not just the volume of cases closed.

  • Monitor behavioural analytics regularly, spot abnormal changes, and turn insights into a

prioritised set of product fixes.

  • Partner across Engineering, Design, Customer Support Operations, Logistics, and Finance to

ship improvements and align on SLAs, policies, and delivery realities.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–4+ years in a product role, ideally in e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer tech.
  • Experience owning customer-facing journeys or post-order / order-management / customer-

support flows.

  • Hands-on with data — comfortable with SQL and analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Looker,

Tableau) to frame hypotheses, run experiments, and measure impact.

  • A systems thinker who maps complex end-to-end flows and finds the highest-leverage fixes.
  • Customer-obsessed, with strong written communication and the ability to influence cross-

functional teams without authority.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to support tooling (Zendesk, Gladly, or similar), conversational automation / chatbots,

and returns or logistics platforms.

  • Familiarity with India's e-commerce dynamics — COD, regional cohorts, and delivery realities.

About Purplle

Purplle is one of India's leading beauty e-commerce platforms, with 30M+ users and one of the most

diverse beauty catalogs in the country. We're building the operating system for beauty — connecting

consumers, brands, and beauty professionals in one ecosystem. This role owns the moment of truth:

what happens after the order, where customer trust is won or kept.

Description

Amazon India is seeking a Product Manager to own and drive delivery experience innovations as the India leader. This is a high-impact role with full ownership of initiatives that directly shape customer delivery experience and Amazon India's delivery economics across millions of orders. You will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for India-specific delivery experience innovations and you will drive adoption of both developed and under-development products to extract maximum value, partnering closely with partners across supply chain, operations, categories and engineering.

We are looking for a strong PM who can dive deep into promise systems, delivery operations, and customer experience, write detailed PRFAQs/PRDs, and deliver features in complex, ambiguous environments. Proficiency with AI-powered tools for rapid experimentation is highly valued. The role offers significant visibility with IES DEX leadership and IN stores leadership.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct responsibility for driving product adoption and value extraction across operations, supply chain, categories, and technology teams
  • Opportunity to leverage AI tools to accelerate product development cycles and experimentation velocity
  • Opportunity to drive India-specific innovations in delivery communication and promise systems
  • Significant cross-functional impact requiring strong stakeholder engagement and change management
  • Direct influence on customer delivery experience for millions of Amazon India customers
  • High visibility with senior leadership across India business and WW DEX teams

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive adoption of developed and under-development products to extract maximum value through strategic stakeholder engagement across operations, supply chain, categories, WW teams, and technology
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate experimentation cycles including rapid PRFAQ writing, prototype development, data analysis, and hypothesis validation
  • Use AI-powered tools to quickly iterate product concepts, create mockups, analyze customer feedback, and generate insights from operational data
  • Build and execute adoption strategies including training, documentation, stakeholder alignment, and change management to ensure products deliver intended business impact
  • Drive India-specific innovations to improve delivery experience, checkout experience and pricing/promotions strategy for millions of India customers.
  • Build deep understanding of promise systems and enable optimal ship option configurations to maximize utilization of available network capacity and capabilities
  • Define and track key performance indicators including delivery reliability metrics, intercept rates, revenue recovery, customer satisfaction, and product adoption rates

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

Prime Video is shaping the future of global digital video entertainment. Our vision is to delight streamers by offering the freshest, richest, and most defect-free catalog of content anywhere. In this cross-functional role you will help define and execute the strategy for the products and services that drive various social media and marketing lifecycle automation. You will collaborate with data science, engineering, operations, other product managers, and executive teams to bring products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our platform capabilities.

The duties will include formulating a business vision for your product domain, gathering business and functional requirements from internal customers and end-users, and translating those requirements into technical specifications to build robust, scalable, and supportable solutions that work well with a range of complex systems. Our vision is to be the world’s most reliable, fastest digital video catalog. We provide partners with the best way to distribute their content and streaming customers with a consistent, reliable experience that works in any device, anywhere.

Our Team

  • Makes data-backed decisions
  • Encourages continuous growing by supporting each together
  • Builds trust across our organization through transparency and communication

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
  • 2+ years of end to end product delivery experience
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Description

Want to transform the way people interact with Alexa leveraging generative AI? Come join the team that is building the next-generation AI-assistant that gets things done across Timers, Alarms, Reminders, Calendars, Recipes, and News on Alexa devices. In this role, you'll drive product strategy and initiatives for a dedicated area within our Alexa Productivity Essentials team focused on driving engaging, high-traffic productivity scenarios for millions of customers worldwide. You’ll work with CX, science and engineering partners to build our next phase in making Alexa the world’s best personal assistant. The role presents an enormous opportunity to impact the customer experience for products that are used every day by people you know. We are looking for someone who is passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, has demonstrated product leadership skills, and thrives in an environment where they collaborate closely with colleagues across product, design, research, science and engineering.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive the architectural and platform vision for the product space
  • Own the roadmap and translate customer requirement into technical specifications
  • Collaborate closely with developers and engineering managers to drive and prioritize the roadmaps and make technical decisions and tradeoffs connected to your product space
  • Recognize and scope new customer opportunities, translating customer needs into business and system requirements
  • Drive project schedules from design to launch
  • Make the right trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
  • Clearly communicate goals, metrics, roles, and responsibilities to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work with senior leaders within Alexa and throughout Amazon

A day in the life

You will own part of the Alexa Productivity Essentials initiative, defining the vision, strategy, product and tech roadmap across experiences loved and used by millions of customers. You will work closely with science, design, research and engineering partners to craft experiences to help customers more seamlessly get more done, and translate that vision into a product roadmap. You will also partner with product teams across Alexa to define how our experiences leverage new innovations in generative AI to help customers accomplish their goals. This is a “Think Big” role where you get to craft the vision and strategy for how customers experience our features across a range of Alexa touch-points.

About The Team

We’re a collaborative team that works closely together, fostering a creative and fun dynamic. We build Alexa experiences that customers connect with on a daily basis, connecting to the essential services that become part of their daily rhythm. The ideal candidate for this role will possess a strong product background with a penchant for cross-team collaboration across business, technical, and design counterparts. They will have deep technical skills and customer centric mindset with a history of launching notable products.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Master's degree in a technical field, or Master of Business Administration
  • Experience working directly with engineering teams
  • Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
  • Previous experience building products that leverage A.I., Machine Learning, Speech/Natural Language Understanding

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management based in India.

This role is focused on defining and shaping the product experience for fleet management solutions used by thousands of operators, dispatchers, and drivers across diverse industries.

The position plays a critical role in translating complex operational challenges into simple, scalable, and data-driven digital workflows that improve safety, efficiency, and cost management.

It involves owning end-to-end product strategy, from roadmap definition to execution, in close collaboration with engineering, design, data science, and go-to-market teams.

The role operates at the intersection of physical operations and advanced technology, leveraging AI and large-scale data to build intelligent fleet management capabilities.

It requires strong analytical thinking, customer empathy, and the ability to align global stakeholders around a unified product vision.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build products that directly influence real-world logistics, transportation, and operational efficiency at scale.

Accountabilities

  • Define and own the product roadmap for key fleet management capabilities, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Translate customer pain points into intuitive web and mobile product experiences that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Collaborate with data science teams to transform large-scale telemetry and sensor data into actionable AI-powered product features.
  • Establish clear success metrics, run experiments, launch beta versions, and iterate based on user feedback and performance data.
  • Partner with engineering, design, sales, marketing, and support teams to deliver cohesive product experiences across global markets.
  • Engage directly with customers, including dispatchers, drivers, and operations teams, to gather insights and validate product decisions.
  • Use data analysis and dashboards to drive product decisions and measure impact on safety, cost, and performance outcomes.

Requirements

  • 4-7 years of experience in B2B product management with ownership of end-to-end product areas.
  • Strong track record of delivering product features that improve operational efficiency, safety, cost, or system uptime.
  • Ability to analyze data, work with dashboards, and use metrics to guide product decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to align diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders across regions.
  • Experience working with logistics, fleet management, telematics, automotive systems, or industrial IoT is a strong plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a user-centric and data-driven mindset.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced environments with multiple competing priorities.
  • Experience working with cross-functional global teams is highly desirable.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with experience and market standards.
  • Opportunity to build and scale impactful fleet management products used globally.
  • Exposure to AI-driven product development and large-scale operational data systems.
  • Remote-friendly work environment based in India.
  • Strong career growth opportunities in a high-impact product organization.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture working across global teams.

Role description: This role is with one of our portfolio companies.


We are hiring a Lead Product Manager for one of our portfolio companies — a high-potential technology firm at a pivotal moment in its growth trajectory. This is the most senior product role within the organisation, and you will be accountable for defining the product vision, shaping the roadmap, and building the necessary discipline to take the company from early traction to significant, scalable impact.


This role offers a rare combination of high autonomy and high accountability. You will work closely with the founders, operate with lean processes, and exercise genuine ownership over product direction and outcomes.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap: Establish the product direction based on fundamental principles; translate business ambitions into a coherent roadmap with clear sequencing, trade-offs, and measurable milestones
  • AI-Native Product Development: Integrate AI meaningfully into core product workflows and user experiences from day one; this is an expectation, not an aspiration
  • Discovery & Problem Framing: Go beyond surface-level requirements; engage deeply with stakeholders to identify second and third-order problems and design solutions built for scalability
  • Enterprise & Integration Readiness: Drive API-first product thinking; understand the technical and security requirements of enterprise clients and build accordingly
  • Execution Ownership: Take full accountability from ideation through launch and iteration; the gap between strategy and delivery is yours to close
  • Team Building & Culture: Lead and develop a small, high-calibre product team; invest in hiring, mentoring, and establishing a culture of ownership and rigour
  • Act as a product evangelist within the organization, aligning stakeholders on product goals and strategies.


What We're Looking For:

Non-negotiables

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; an MBA from a Tier 1 institution is preferred
  • 8–12 years of progressive product management experience, with a minimum of 3–4 years in a role carrying full product ownership and strategic accountability
  • A proven track record in building 0-1 products, owning and executing product strategy throughout the entire product lifecycle, from inception to go-to-market.
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/ML into live products; conceptual familiarity is not sufficient
  • Deep understanding of B2B or B2B2C product dynamics — the ability to serve both enterprise buyers and end users with equal clarity
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments where the playbook does not yet exist
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — capable of effectively engaging with a founder, a CTO, and a junior PM


Strong Differentiators

  • Prior experience in regulated industries — including fintech, legaltech, insurtech, or similar domains
  • Exposure to API-first or platform product development
  • Experience with enterprise onboarding processes, integration complexities, or compliance-heavy product requirements
  • A track record of building product teams and establishing PM culture in early-stage environments


Note: We will check the fitment for multiple roles across our portfolios.
