Job Title: Senior Manager – PM

Experience: 10+ years

Location: Bangalore (On-site)


Role Summary

You will be part of the Product Management team for the Lending portfolio, with a strong focus on Loan Management and Servicing platforms. This role involves working closely with the Product Director, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to design, build, and enhance scalable lending products used by banks and financial institutions globally.

Your primary responsibility will be to own and evolve product capabilities across the loan lifecycle, ensuring regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, configurability, and superior customer experience. You will translate complex lending domain requirements into clear product roadmaps and deliverables.


What Will You Do?

  • Define and execute product vision and roadmap for loan management systems aligned with business and market needs.
  • Own key lending modules including loan servicing, interest & fee management, repayments, collections, restructuring, and closures.
  • Act as the domain expert for retail, corporate, and SME lending, covering the full loan lifecycle.
  • Prioritize requirements based on customer value, regulatory needs, and commercial impact.
  • Collaborate with engineering, QA, UX, sales, and implementation teams to deliver high-quality releases.
  • Engage with customers and partners to capture real-world lending use cases and support pre-sales discussions.
  • Create PRDs, user stories, and functional documentation in Agile environments (Jira, Confluence).
  • Track product performance post-release and drive continuous improvements.


Skills & Qualifications Required

  • 10+ years of product management experience in BFSI lending or loan management platforms.
  • Strong experience in B2B enterprise software products.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology (B.Tech or equivalent).
  • Deep expertise in loan lifecycle management, including EMI/interest calculations, collections, delinquency, restructuring, and closures.
  • Exposure to retail, corporate, SME, or Islamic lending is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs, databases, configurable platforms, and Agile tools (Jira, Confluence).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives with an ownership-driven mindset.

Senior Product Manager

Full-Time | Product & Technology | Remote (India Only) / Hybrid

About The Role

AI/ML Experience Required Telephony Knowledge a Plus

We are building a cutting-edge platform that tests Generative AI-based Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems through real, automated phone calls — helping enterprises validate, benchmark, and improve their AI-powered voice experiences before they reach end customers. This is a high-impact space at the intersection of conversational AI, telephony, and quality engineering.

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end product lifecycle — from vision and strategy through discovery, delivery, and post-launch optimization. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, design, QA, sales, and marketing, and will play a pivotal role in shaping a product that sits at the forefront of AI-driven communication testing.

The ideal candidate has direct, hands-on experience managing AI/ML products and a strong intuition for how large language models and generative AI systems behave in production. Familiarity with telephony infrastructure and IVR systems will set you apart.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy & Vision

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Gen AI IVR testing platform, aligned with business goals.
  • Act as the voice of the customer while balancing long-term product scalability.
  • Monitor product performance using KPIs, analytics, and customer feedback to make data-driven decisions.

Discovery & Requirements

  • Gather, analyze, and prioritize requirements from clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders.
  • Translate customer needs and market insights around AI/ML and conversational voice systems into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Lead product discovery, validation, and feature definition using data and customer feedback.
  • Prioritize the product backlog to balance customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, QA, sales, and marketing teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Partner with AI/ML engineers to define model evaluation criteria, testing frameworks, and performance benchmarks.
  • Conduct internal product demos and walkthroughs for stakeholders prior to customer release.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations across regions and time zones.
  • Drive successful product launches and coordinate go-to-market activities.

Documentation, Compliance & Launch Readiness

  • Own and maintain comprehensive product documentation, ensuring it is accurate, up to date, and accessible.
  • Ensure product compliance with regional regulations, security standards, and client requirements.
  • Ensure product readiness by aligning documentation, training, and release materials before launch.
  • Make data-driven decisions to improve product adoption, usability, and customer satisfaction.

What You BringRequired Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead PM role.
  • Proven track record of defining and shipping successful B2B or B2C products at scale.
  • Hands-on experience managing AI/ML products — you understand model lifecycles, evaluation pipelines, and the nuances of shipping AI-powered features to production. (Must Have)
  • Familiarity with Generative AI concepts including LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, and AI evaluation/testing methodologies.
  • Strong ability to write clear, concise product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and backlog management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Redmine).
  • Excellent analytical skills — comfortable working with data, dashboards, and product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker).
  • Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present to diverse audiences.
  • Experience owning go-to-market coordination and product launch activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of telephony systems, IVR platforms, and voice infrastructure (e.g., SIP, VoIP, Twilio, Genesys, Avaya, Amazon Connect) is a significant advantage. (Big Plus)
  • Experience with QA, testing, or DevOps tooling for AI systems.
  • Background in SaaS, conversational AI, contact centre, or enterprise voice platforms.
  • Experience with compliance-sensitive products (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, regional data regulations).
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) strategies.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus, but not required.

About the Company



SquadStack.ai is on a mission to transform the $450B global customer experience market. We’re building an AI-native, vertically integrated platform that combines AI agents, human agents, software and deep workflow orchestration to deliver sales & cx services-as-software at scale. If you’re excited about building products at the frontier of AI, voice, and platform abstraction—this is your playground.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Product Manager who’s equal parts strategist, builder, and visionary—someone who wants to shape the future of AI in customer experience. In this role, you’ll lead the development of our Voice AI platform and the go-to-market for our agentic voice AI. This is a high-ownership, zero-to-one opportunity to define product strategy, scale infrastructure, and empower developers and businesses to build with SquadStack’s AI capabilities.



Responsibilities



  • Product Strategy & Vision
  • Define and lead the roadmap for our Voice AI platform, aligning product initiatives with the company vision.
  • Work with leadership to translate abstract ideas into product strategy and modular platform offerings.
  • Stay ahead of trends in LLMs, agentic workflows, voice AI, and platform ecosystems.
  • Product Development & Execution
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, and data science to ship high-quality, high-leverage products.
  • Translate user needs into APIs, SDKs, and platform components that external teams can build on.
  • Lead the product lifecycle end-to-end—from problem discovery to post-launch iteration.
  • Go-to-Market & Ecosystem Building
  • Design a thoughtful GTM strategy with business teams: pricing, positioning, self-serve onboarding, and documentation.
  • Work closely with sales, marketing, and success to drive adoption across enterprises and SMEs.
  • Gather feedback from early adopters, devs, and internal users to iterate fast.
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Serve as the product bridge across internal teams (infra, sales, CX ops).
  • Evangelise platform thinking across the company—driving clarity on where we build vs expose.


  • Qualifications



    • 7-8 years of experience in product management, preferably in AI, SaaS, or PaaS.
    • Ex-Engineers or Technical/ Data Background (but now product-focused).
    • Understand AI-native or workflow orchestration products.
    • Have worked on extensible platforms or developer products.
    • Can marry infra thinking with product-led GTM, and build for both enterprise and SME/long-tail devs.
    • Clear, compelling communication—can explain complex concepts to both engineers and execs.


    Preferred Skills



    • Hands-on experience building or launching PaaS or workflow automation tools.
    • Founder or early-stage startup experience—bias for action and clarity under chaos.
    • Exposure to LLM tooling, voice AI, or agentic workflows.


    Pay range and compensation package



    Compensation: Competitive!



    Joining: ASAP!



    Location: Noida



    Equal Opportunity Statement



    Why join us? Build at the cutting edge of AI & CX. Work with a high-context team that values speed, clarity, and ambition. Influence not just product, but company direction—PMs become revenue drivers at our org. Competitive salary, ESOPs, and the opportunity to own a large surface area of impact.

Who You'll Work With

We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Manager to own and scale Nike’s Inventory Decision Platform for omnichannel fulfillment, a mission-critical capability to enable intelligent inventory forecasting and allocation decisions, demand-supply matching across channels and fulfilment node and optimised inventory utilisation,

As a Lead Product Manager working in the Supply Chain Planning technology team, you will operate at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Global Supply chain operations, driving the inventory decisioning platform at scale.

You Will Partner Closely With

  • Engineering and Data Science teams building optimisation and decision systems
  • Global & Geo Supply Chain teams managing inventory flow, allocation policies, and execution
  • Product, Architecture, and Data teams shaping the broader planning and inventory ecosystem
  • Business stakeholders across digital, retail, and fulfilment channels

You will act as the single point owner enabling the success of inventory decisioning products by aligning business priorities with technology strategy and execution.

Who We Are Looking For

  • 8–12 years of experience in Product Management and atleast 3+ years as a Product lead for Supply Chain domains
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, MBA preferred
  • Strong supply chain depth (inventory, planning, or fulfilment domains)
  • Experience working in global, cross-functional environments
  • Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence senior leaders
  • Ability to translate complex business problems into clear product direction
  • Data-driven mindset with focus on decisioning, trade-offs, and business outcomes
  • Clear and crisp communication adapted to technical and business audiences
  • Familiarity with supply chain forecasting / optimisation models or ML-driven decision systems
  • Nice to have exposure to packaged solutions like O9, Blue Yonder

What You'll Work On

As a Lead Product manager you will bring in

Inventory Decisions Domain Expertise

  • To drive omnichannel fulfilment capabilities across inventory forecasting, allocation, replenishment, visibility and deployment
  • Define decision logic for balancing: - Demand vs supply | Channel and marketplace priorities | Service levels, speed, and profitability
  • Enable dynamic decisioning using real-time signals, constraints, and optimisation logic
  • Partner with business teams to evolve policies, rules, and decision frameworks

Product Excellence

  • Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and delivery
  • Translate complex supply chain problems into scalable decisioning platform capabilities
  • Manage backlog, prioritisation, and execution with engineering and data science teams
  • Drive PI planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery tracking
  • Track value, adoption, and business impact (e.g., service levels, inventory utilisation, decision accuracy)

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Noora Health India Private Limited is a key partner in Noora Health’s mission is to improve outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with the skills they need to care for their loved ones. They develop content, technology platforms, new products, and strengthen other operational functions that support the scale and impact of Noora Health’s programs.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 58 million caregivers and patients across 16,300+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

About The Role

The Mobile Care Companion (MCC) is Noora Health's primary digital touchpoint for family caregivers post discharge, serving ~50,000 users a day across India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal. It delivers behavior change and health system navigation at scale through two-way conversations, clinical triage, care coordination, and a growing set of AI-powered features.

This role owns MCC end-to-end: the caregiver experience, the health worker tools, the clinical workflows, and the AI layer that cuts across all of it. You will define what MCC becomes over the next three years, be accountable for both growth and outcomes, and lead an interdisciplinary team spanning product, clinical, data, and program functions to get there.

What You Will Do

  • Overall Model: Own the growth and operating model for MCC across user acquisition, activation, and retention at scale, including how MCC is positioned, priced, and deployed across government health systems and private partners
  • AI-led Product Experience: Reimagine the delivery with an AI-first thinking. Reason through where AI owns, where it assists, and where the experts jump in. Embed AI with an eval-led approach iterating to improve accuracy, engagement, and behavior change.
  • Product Roadmap: Set and execute the product roadmap to improve the user experience across the full funnel. Work with country program teams to translate local context (language, literacy, health system constraints) into product decisions that hold across four countries
  • Management & Execution: Deliver individually while also managing and mentoring a team of PMs, designers, clinicians across geographies.
  • Partnership & Advocacy: Represent the product with key internal and external stakeholders including health system partners, funders, leadership, and country teams to drive buy-in and unlock partnerships to drive MCC’s growth.

Who Are We Looking For

  • A 0-to-1 builder/founder: You have taken at least one product from concept to production to scale in a resource-constrained environment and owned its outcomes. You don't need scaffolding to get started
  • 6–12 years of product experience, with a meaningful share on AI-powered products; Hands-on fluency with LLMs: prompt design, retrieval architectures, eval pipelines, MCPs, and optimization workflows
  • Deeply data fluent and strong experimentation instinct: you obsesses about data, you define what good looks like before you build, and you are rigorous about measuring it
  • A first-principles thinker about complex service design. You are quick to build prototypes, sketch flows, write copies, and analyze and cut data to make your vision concrete
  • Able to work across clinical and technical teams, earn credibility with both, and translate between them clearly

descriptionHtml:
Your Impact

The Senior Product Manager for AI Platform at DISCO is responsible for driving the product strategy and execution for our centralized AI infrastructure. They lead a high-velocity functional team and collaborate with US-based experience groups to deliver innovative, reusable services that power legal outcomes across our product suite. By bridging the gap between technical research and production reality, they use customer needs and business goals to shape the roadmap for DISCO's AI foundation. They will own their platform’s outcomes, provide strategic clarity to global stakeholders, and ensure our technology is scalable, defensible, and cost-effective.

What You'll Do

  • Drive AI Platform Strategy: Lead the investment plan that best enables teams to leverage AI capabilities across all DISCO products while partnering with engineering on the technical approach and priority order.
  • Lead for Delivery: Partner with your team of engineers in the Gurugram office to translate technical research into production-ready services with high velocity.
  • Shape the Infrastructure Roadmap: Collaborate with leaders in engineering and product journeys to prioritize and deliver plug-and-play services that unblock feature teams.
  • Deliver Strategic Outcomes: Partner across DISCO to ensure wide-scale adoption of platform services, measuring success by the increased efficiency and cost-effectiveness of our legal technology solutions.

Who You Are

  • Experience: 5-8+ years of Product Management experience, with a proven track record of scaling internal platforms to serve multiple business units at enterprise scale while managing backend services, developer platforms, or complex AI-powered features.
  • B2B Platform Strategist: You provide strategic clarity by translating complex stakeholder needs into a definitive roadmap and ensure every platform investment is tied to trackable outcomes.
  • Outcome-Oriented Leader: You break complex problems into achievable milestones and relentlessly prioritize speed-to-market and ROI over technical perfection.
  • Global Operator: You thrive on autonomy, mastering async communication to run complex projects and lead teams across 10+ hour timezone (CST to IST) gaps.
  • Technical Partner: You can navigate architectural discussions regarding RAG, model lifecycles, and vector databases while remaining focused on user impact.

Even Better If You Have...

  • A portfolio of high-scale AI products delivered to enterprise users.
  • Legal tech experience or a deep understanding of the legal domain.

Core DISCO Product Competencies

  • Customer Focus & Insight: Deeply understand user needs and pain points through research to guide product decisions.
  • Strategic Clarity: Create and communicate clear direction aligned with business goals and measurable outcomes.
  • Delivery of Top Priorities: Drive high-quality and timely delivery of the most important new products and experiences.
  • Own the Outcome: Take full responsibility for achieving results and measurable impact from definition through iteration.

Perks of DISCO

  • Open, inclusive, and fun environment
  • Benefits, including medical and dental insurance
  • Competitive salary plus discretionary bonus
  • Opportunity to be a part of a startup that is revolutionizing the legal industry
  • Growth opportunities throughout the company

About DISCO

DISCO provides a cloud-native, artificial intelligence-powered legal solution that simplifies ediscovery, legal document review and case management for enterprises, law firms, legal services providers and governments. Our scalable, integrated solution enables legal departments to easily collect, process and review enterprise data that is relevant or potentially relevant to legal matters.

At DISCO, we believe AI is a core enabler of how work gets done. All employees are expected to proactively adopt and responsibly use AI tools to drive efficiency, improve outcomes, and continuously evolve how they operate in their role.

Are you ready to help us fulfill our mission to use technology to strengthen the rule of law? Join us!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Short Summary


Skills: Excellent communication skills. Good with software products

Experience: 3+ years of experience at a SaaS company

Office location: Gurgaon, at Patina tower, near Sikanderpur metro station, DLF Phase 1

Company website: https://www.sumtracker.com


We are an in-office company with a 5-day work week.


About the company


Sumtracker is a fast-growing SaaS startup revolutionising inventory management for e-commerce businesses worldwide. Founded by IIT Delhi alumni Ankit and Kush in 2022, we support a global client base across the US, UK, Australia, and beyond.


We're building the future of inventory management - from real-time stock sync across channels to AI-powered forecasting and intelligent automation. Our platform helps e-commerce merchants stay ahead with AI tools that make smarter inventory decisions, reduce stockouts, and streamline operations. We're driven to become the industry leader in this exciting space and are moving fast to get there.


Join us as we make a real difference in the lives of online sellers!


About the role


We are looking for a driven and customer-focused professional to join our team and take ownership of the complete customer journey - from first conversation to long-term success.

This is a full-cycle role where you'll be responsible for converting new signups into paying customers, onboarding them onto the platform, and ensuring they get maximum value from Sumtracker. You'll work closely with the product team to improve the product based on real customer feedback.


If you enjoy wearing multiple hats, talking to customers, and building relationships, this role is for you.


Responsibilities

This is a high-ownership individual contributor role.


  • Convert new signups: Engage with trial users through email, chat, and video calls. Conduct product demos and convert them into paying customers
  • Onboard customers: Guide new customers through setup and ensure they're using the product effectively
  • Provide support: Answer customer questions and resolve issues via chat, email, and calls.
  • Gather feedback: Collect customer feedback, identify pain points, and coordinate with the product team to drive improvements
  • Product improvements: Gather and organise bugs, improvement proposals and feature requests and coordinate with the product team to get those implemented
  • Build automated workflows: Identify repetitive processes across customer touchpoints and develop automated workflows to improve efficiency and scale customer success operations
  • Drive growth: Take full ownership of retention, expansion, and customer satisfaction metrics - proactively identifying opportunities to grow accounts and improve outcomes
  • Proactive Customer Success: Proactively engage with clients, build strong relationships, and ensure they have an exceptional experience with our product


Qualifications


  • Proven Experience: 3+ years of experience at a SaaS company
  • Excellent Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts
  • Customer-Centric Approach: A genuine passion for helping customers succeed and a strong commitment to providing outstanding service
  • Ownership-Driven: Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage multiple tasks effectively


Why should you join us?


  • Competitive compensation: Attractive salary with annual increments
  • Growth opportunities: Take on a pivotal role with full ownership, accelerating your career
  • Global exposure: Work with customers across the US, UK, Australia, and more
  • Cutting-edge work: Solve real problems using AI and modern tools


Team and culture

At Sumtracker, we foster a culture that values autonomy, ownership, and transparency.


  • Process-driven and autonomous: Well-defined processes that empower you to work independently
  • Transparency: Open communication about company progress and individual contributions
  • Direct access: Share your thoughts and ideas directly with the founders
  • Great workspace: Work from our office at WeWork Platina Tower
  • Continuous learning: Enhance your skills with company-sponsored courses

descriptionHtml:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Job Description

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • As a Product Manager for ETM Identity, you will be responsible for translating customer use cases into actionable user stories and epics for developers.
  • Collaborate with a cross functional team on solution architecture and feature design as well as drive engineering deliverables from conception to delivery.
  • Work with engineering, solution architect(s) and other key stakeholders to ensure features delivered map to real world usage, translating customer feedback into new feature requests and feature refinements.
  • Work directly with engineering management to ensure delivery of defined product features on time.
  • Attend and drive engineering grooming sessions and regular scrum meetings to ensure proper PM input when needed for engineering priorities.
  • Collaborate with broader PM team on prioritization of the product backlogs to develop and maintain roadmaps for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Define personas for each product capability and ensure those personas reflect each class of customer, stakeholder and internal resources that use the products
  • Deliver product feature/solution demonstrations to customers
  • Working closely with UX/ UI experts to create an intuitive and state of the art user interface
  • Track relevant product competition and ensure sales and marketing has the material needed to maximize sales efforts relative to competitors


Desired Skills, Experience, and Qualifications:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to create enablement collateral (presentations, whitepapers, demos, etc.)
  • The candidate must possess a product management background with two years of proven product management experience, preferably in cyber security. Other equivalent techno-functional experience in cyber security can also be considered.
  • Experience and deep understanding of Identity and Access Management, adjacent areas, and broader cyber security domain is preferred.
  • Ability to define clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritize feature backlogs using Agile methodologies.

descriptionHtml:
What You'll Do

Avalara is looking for a Senior Product Manager, AI Experience to define AI-first digital experiences that help customers configure, onboard, and go live with the products they have purchased. You will initially focus on a strategic post-sales customer lifecycle program, shaping self-service and agentic workflows that reduce manual onboarding steps and create clearer, more trusted customer experiences. You will report to the Senior Director of Digital Platform and Customer Experience and partners across product, design, engineering, customer support, and operations. You will help Avalara improve time to go-live, customer experience, onboarding capacity, operational efficiency, revenue acceleration, and customer retention.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Own the product roadmap for AI-first onboarding and go-live experiences, aligned to customer needs, business goals, and cross-functional priorities.
  • Define self-service and AI-driven customer workflows that help customers configure, onboard, and go live with Avalara products.
  • Translate customer needs, onboarding friction, operational constraints, and business goals into clear requirements, workflow models, success measures, and release priorities.
  • Partner with product, design, engineering, customer support, operations, and other teams to create intuitive, scalable, and trusted customer experiences.
  • Use AI-assisted product and user experience tools to create lightweight artefacts such as journey maps, workflow models, experience concepts, prototypes, and decision documents.
  • Shape future-state experiences that combine human workflows, self-service tools, conversational agents, product interfaces, application programming interfaces, model context protocol capabilities, and domain-specific agents.
  • Find opportunities to simplify onboarding by guiding customers through the right mix of self-service, AI-assisted, and human-supported paths.
  • Apply responsible AI practices when defining customer-facing workflows, including data privacy, bias mitigation, hallucination risk, explainability, and appropriate human review.
  • Share AI methods, prompts, patterns, and learnings with product, design, and engineering partners to improve team capability.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Digital Product Design, or a related technical field.
  • 6+ years of product management experience in software, software as a service, platform, digital experience, workflow, or customer lifecycle products.
  • Experience building AI-first or automation-supported customer experiences, such as conversational agents, agentic workflows, guided self-service flows, or intelligent product experiences.
  • Experience with post-sales customer lifecycle products or workflows, such as onboarding, activation, adoption, support, retention, or customer success.
  • Collaboration with the ability to explain complex workflows, tradeoffs, and responsible AI considerations across product, design, engineering, customer support, operations, and business stakeholders.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Team

The Workflows Module is the key component of HighLevel’s automation engine, enabling agencies and businesses to create powerful, automated workflows that enhance efficiency, save time, and improve outcomes. By integrating with multiple product areas within the HighLevel platform and external apps, the Workflows Module empowers users to streamline processes, nurture leads, and manage tasks seamlessly.

The Workflows extended team powers the extensibility layer of HighLevel. Integrations are critical to enabling agencies and businesses to connect their external ecosystem - CRMs, email systems, form builders, contact tools, and other SaaS platforms - into HighLevel workflows.

This team focuses on building deep, reliable, and scalable integrations that go beyond surface-level triggers and actions. The goal is to reduce framework gaps, improve time-to-ship for integrations, and ensure that integrations meaningfully drive workflow adoption, activation, and retention.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Workflows Team, with a strong focus on Integrations, Framework Enablement, and Vertical Ownership. This role is ideal for a self-driven individual who is passionate about automation, SaaS ecosystems, and building scalable platform capabilities.

As a SPM, you will lead the strategy and execution for integration verticals such as CRMs, Forms, Email Systems, and other key ecosystem partners. You will own these verticals end-to-end - from API evaluation and framework readiness to configuration design, user experience, adoption, performance, and long-term reliability.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, partnerships, and other product managers to deeply understand user pain points and ecosystem opportunities. Your responsibility will be to translate these insights into scalable framework improvements and high-impact integrations that make it easier for users to automate complex business processes.

Beyond shipping integrations, you will proactively identify framework gaps before they become delivery bottlenecks, reduce integration time-to-ship, and ensure every integration meaningfully drives workflow usage, customer adoption, and ecosystem growth. You will leverage data, user insights, and structured experimentation to continuously improve integration performance and product impact.

Your Responsibilities

  • Integration & Marketplace Ownership: Own marketplace and integration vertical(s) such as CRMs, Forms, Email Systems, or Contact Platforms end-to-end, including roadmap, delivery, reliability, and adoption.
  • API & Configuration Definition: Review third-party API documentation and define integration configurations including authentication flows (OAuth, API keys), field mapping, data types, webhooks, polling strategies, pagination, rate limits, retries, and UI configuration controls.
  • Framework Gap Identification: Proactively identify missing workflow framework primitives and drive fixes before engineering execution begins to avoid reactive delivery slowdowns.
  • Adoption & Activation: Ensure integrations are deeply leveraged by improving trigger/action quality, importer flows, data parity, and workflow entry points such as hotlinks and breadcrumbs to increase activation and usage.
  • Reliability & Quality: Improve integration reliability, success rates, and execution consistency across triggers and actions.
  • Support Insight to Product Fixes: Analyze integration-related support tickets and ecosystem feedback to identify recurring friction and drive product improvements.
  • Tracking Metrics: Track integration time-to-ship, triggers/actions shipped per sprint, workflow usage tied to integrations, and reliability metrics to continuously improve performance.
  • Documentation & Enablement: Partner with documentation and AI teams to build high-quality help content and structured knowledge for both customers and AI-driven assistance.
  • Staying updated on industry trends in APIs, ecosystem integrations, automation platforms, and no-code/low-code tools to drive innovation within workflows.

Your Core Skills

  • Experience in one or more of the following:
  • Product Management
  • Platform or API-based Products
  • SaaS Integrations or Ecosystem Platforms
  • Passionate about building intuitive and scalable workflow automation solutions.
  • Ability to deeply understand user problems, spot friction in product flows, and make thoughtful trade-offs between power and simplicity.
  • Strong understanding of API concepts including OAuth, REST APIs, webhooks, pagination, rate limits, and data modeling.
